title: Artificial Intelligence, Competition, and Welfare
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Competition, and Welfare
detail.abstract:
We study how market power in artificial intelligence (AI) shapes wages and welfare in open-economy general equilibrium by treating AI as a priced, imported factor. Across three models, we separate technical efficiency from the impact of upstream price setting. In a two-traded-goods benchmark, the incidence of AI price changes depends on how sectoral skill intensity changes with AI prices; non-monotone intensity can generate “double harm” for unskilled workers (lower real wage after a large decrease in the price of AI, and real wage decreases further when the AI price rises as a result of market power). With one non-traded sector, we observe that the classic “Dutch disease” effect here would arise when one sector gets more productive and draws labor away from other sectors, creating scarcity and raising prices; but this is not what we expect from the introduction of labor-substituting AI. In contrast, our last model considers two non-traded sectors and CES/free entry, and the opportunity for discrete adoption of technology that replaces unskilled labor from the AI-using sector. When AI reduces unit costs and increases variety, it will not pull U from non-tradables, instead it will displace workers from the AI-using sector and lower wage due to diminishing returns in alternative sectors. Strategic upstream pricing of AI then harms welfare through unit-cost (usage fees) and variety (access fees) channels, with income leakage abroad. We derive an adoption frontier tying feasible usage prices to displaced workers’ outside options and show a monopolist typically prices on this boundary; capping one instrument shifts rents to the other. Broad gains for the adopting country relies on pressure (or regulation) on both usage and access fees and as well as policy that supports productive absorption of displaced labor. The framework clarifies when AI can lower real wages and aggregate welfare despite efficiency gains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了AI市场力量如何通过将AI视为定价的进口要素来影响开放经济中的工资和福利。研究发现，AI价格变化的影响取决于部门技能强度如何随AI价格变化，AI可能对非熟练工人造成"双重伤害"。在非贸易部门模型中，AI不会像传统荷兰病那样拉动劳动力，而是会替代AI使用部门的工人并降低工资。战略性的AI上游定价通过单位成本和多样性渠道损害福利，需要同时监管使用费和接入费才能实现广泛收益。
AI.research_question: AI市场力量如何影响开放经济中的工资和福利分配？
AI.motivation: 理解AI作为定价进口要素时，其市场力量对经济均衡的影响，特别是对工资和福利的分配效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济一般均衡理论、要素价格理论、市场力量理论、荷兰病理论
AI.method: 构建三个理论模型：双贸易品基准模型、单一非贸易部门模型、双非贸易部门CES/自由进入模型
AI.findings: 1) AI价格变化的影响取决于部门技能强度变化；2) AI不会产生传统荷兰病效应；3) 战略性AI定价通过单位成本和多样性渠道损害福利；4) 垄断者通常在采用边界上定价
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将AI作为定价进口要素纳入一般均衡分析；2) 分离技术效率与上游定价影响；3) 推导AI采用边界；4) 阐明AI可能降低实际工资和总福利的条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AI监管政策提供理论依据；2) 强调需要同时监管使用费和接入费；3) 提出支持被替代劳动力生产性吸收的政策建议

title: Probability Pricing
affiliations: Yale University - Department of Economics, New York University (NYU) - New York University and Imperial College London

detail.title: Probability Pricing
detail.abstract:
This paper develops probability pricing, extending cash flow pricing to quantify the willingness-to-pay for changes in probabilities. We show that the value of any marginal change in probabilities can be expressed as a standard asset-pricing formula with hypothetical cash flows derived from changes in the survival function. This equivalence between probability and cash flow valuation allows us to construct hedging strategies and systematically decompose individual and aggregate willingness-to-pay. Four applications examine the valuation of changes in the distribution of aggregate consumption, the efficiency effects of varying performance precision in principal-agent problems, and the welfare implications of public and private information.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了概率定价方法，将现金流定价扩展到量化对概率变化的支付意愿。研究表明，任何边际概率变化的价值都可以表示为标准资产定价公式，其中假设现金流来自生存函数的变化。这种概率与现金流估值的等价性使我们能够构建对冲策略，并系统分解个体和总体的支付意愿。
AI.research_question: 如何量化对概率变化的支付意愿？概率定价与现金流定价之间是否存在等价关系？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价主要关注现金流，但许多经济决策涉及概率变化而非直接的现金流变化，需要扩展定价理论来量化概率变化的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率定价理论、资产定价理论、生存函数分析、支付意愿分解
AI.method: 理论推导和数学建模，构建概率变化与现金流变化的等价关系，并通过生存函数推导假设现金流
AI.findings: 概率变化的价值可以用标准资产定价公式表示；概率定价与现金流定价具有等价性；可以构建对冲策略来管理概率风险；能够系统分解个体和总体的支付意愿
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了资产定价理论，建立了概率定价框架；证明了概率变化与现金流变化的等价关系；提供了分析概率风险的新工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估概率变化的价值提供了实用方法；有助于构建概率风险对冲策略；在消费分布变化、委托代理问题、信息价值评估等领域有应用价值

title: Demand Elasticity in Dynamic Asset Pricing
affiliations: Stanford University, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), Central European University (CEU) and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Demand Elasticity in Dynamic Asset Pricing
detail.abstract:
Standard demand elasticity estimation treats investors' demand slopes as stable objects that can be traced out by exogenous residual supply shifts. We show this identification strategy fails in dynamic settings: supply shocks cause demand curves to tilt and shift through general equilibrium effects. The mechanism is intuitive—investors' demand depends on the entire distribution of current and future returns, including volatility, covariances, and correlations with investment opportunities. Supply shocks that change today's prices inevitably reshape future return distributions, moving the demand curve itself. We develop and calibrate a dynamic model to quantify this mismeasurement. The measured slope is approximately 40% of its conceptual counterpart, implying that demand curves are substantially steeper than estimated. This distortion operates through two channels: endogenous risk (altered volatility and covariances) and amplified intertemporal hedging (changed correlation with investment opportunities). The distortion remains sizable even for infinitesimal or purely transitory shocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 传统需求弹性估计方法在动态环境中失效，供给冲击会通过一般均衡效应导致需求曲线倾斜和移动。研究发现测量斜率仅为概念对应值的40%，表明需求曲线实际上比估计的要陡峭得多。
AI.research_question: 在动态环境中，供给冲击如何影响投资者需求曲线的识别和测量？
AI.motivation: 传统需求弹性估计方法假设投资者需求斜率是稳定的，可以通过外生供给冲击来识别，但这种识别策略在动态环境中可能失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态资产定价理论，考虑投资者需求依赖于当前和未来收益的整个分布，包括波动率、协方差和与投资机会的相关性。
AI.method: 开发和校准动态模型来量化测量误差，分析供给冲击对需求曲线的影响机制。
AI.findings: 测量斜率约为概念对应值的40%，需求曲线实际上比估计的要陡峭得多。扭曲通过两个渠道运作：内生风险（改变的波动率和协方差）和放大的跨期对冲（与投资机会相关性的变化）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统需求弹性估计方法在动态环境中的局限性，提出了考虑一般均衡效应的动态需求曲线识别框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了更准确的需求曲线估计方法，有助于更好地理解市场动态和资产定价。

title: Present Bias and Discount Rate Risk
affiliations: , BI Norwegian Business School and BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Present Bias and Discount Rate Risk
detail.abstract:
Recent evidence in the psychology literature suggests that individuals' degree of present bias varies with the state of nature and increases under stress. Consistent with this notion, we document, using survey data on individuals’ expected and realized consumption growth, that agents indeed tend to overconsume relative to their expectations and that the degree of such overconsumption is higher in bad times. We analyze the asset pricing implications of this bias and show that even if they control a small fraction of wealth, investors with time-varying degree of present bias cause substantial, priced discount rate risks that have first-order impact on the level and time-variation of asset risk premiums. The mechanism is distinct from that of models with time-varying preference parameters and that of models with biased expectations about aggregate outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: The Effects of Immigration Enforcement on Student Outcomes in a New Era of Immigration Policy in the United States

detail.title: The Effects of Immigration Enforcement on Student Outcomes in a New Era of Immigration Policy in the United States
detail.abstract:
This study presents the first evidence, to our knowledge, of the effects of the surge in interior immigration apprehensions in 2025 in the United States on student academic performance using detailed student-level administrative records from Florida. We find evidence that immigration enforcement reduced test scores for both U.S.-born and foreign-born Spanish-speaking students while also reducing the likelihood that these students are involved in disciplinary incidents in schools. Both of these effects are more pronounced for students in middle and high schools.

title: Multivariate Ordered Discrete Response Models with Lattice Structures
affiliations: and University of London, Royal Holloway College - Department of Economics

detail.title: Multivariate Ordered Discrete Response Models with Lattice Structures
detail.abstract: We analyze multivariate ordered discrete response models with a lattice structure, modeling decision makers who narrowly bracket choices across multiple dimensions. These models map latent continuous processes into discrete responses using functionally independent decision thresholds. In a semiparametric framework, we model latent processes as sums of covariate indices and unobserved errors and derive conditions for identifying index parameters, thresholds, and the joint cumulative distribution function of the errors. For the parametric bivariate probit case, we separately derive identification of regression parameters and thresholds, and the correlation parameter, with the latter requiring additional covariate restrictions. We outline estimation approaches for semiparametric and parametric models, present simulations illustrating the performance of estimators for lattice models, and provide an application on the relationship between health and happiness rankings.

title: Then and Now: A Look Back and Ahead at the Federal Budget
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and Brookings Institution

detail.title: Then and Now: A Look Back and Ahead at the Federal Budget
detail.abstract:
It is well-understood that the U.S. faces an unsustainable fiscal future. We review historical budget trends and basic fiscal processes. We provide new estimates of the budget outlook, incorporating the recently enacted One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), and finding that the debt-GDP ratio will rise to 183% in 2054 under the OBBBA as legislated and to 199% if the temporary tax and spending provisions are made permanent. These figures compare to a current debt-GDP ratio of about 100% and a pre-OBBBA CBO analysis earlier this year that projected the 2054 debt-GDP ratio to be 154%. We estimate a fiscal gap – the permanent tax or spending changes needed to keep the 2054 debt-GDP ratio at its current level – to be about 3.4% of GDP if OBBBA is extended. We discuss the economic and political ramifications of debt and different ways to address the fiscal situation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Does Regulation Distort Exit Decisions? Evidence from U.S. Power Plants
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Does Regulation Distort Exit Decisions? Evidence from U.S. Power Plants
detail.abstract:
Hundreds of power plants have closed in the United States since 2010, including 130+ gigawatts of coal and 50+ gigawatts of natural gas. In this paper, we highlight the potential for regulation to distort this type of exit decision. Using generator-level data from 2010–2023, we show that regulated units have been 45% less likely to exit than unregulated units. For unregulated units, exit decisions are made based on wholesale electricity prices, ongoing capital costs, and other traditional economic factors. In contrast, owners of regulated units are largely insulated from these factors and, in some cases, have a strong incentive to continue operating capital-intensive equipment. Previous work documents how this regulatory distortion affects investment decisions. Our paper emphasizes that these same incentives affect exit decisions as well.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: The Consequences of Faculty Sexual Misconduct
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: The Consequences of Faculty Sexual Misconduct
detail.abstract:
Faculty sexual misconduct targeted at students is a widespread problem. The consequences of such incidents include direct harm to victims and may also entail a loss to science if students who encounter misconduct become discouraged from continuing their studies in their chosen field. We link publicly available information on degree completion by institution, academic field, and gender to a database of faculty sexual misconduct incidents verified in the media or court cases. Then, we employ a stacked event study approach to document the extent to which faculty sexual misconduct decreases in-field degree completion. Exposure to a field-specific faculty sexual misconduct incident decreases degree completion in that field by 3.4 percent four years after the incident. This decline is driven by incidents occurring after 2015, among which we observe a 7 percent decline in in-field degree completion. Students exit majors dominated by men, but this shift has little effect on predicted earnings because students shift away from both high- and low-earning majors.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: How do Macroeconomic Conditions affect Banks’ Performance in Nigeria?
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria, Abuja, Central Bank of Nigeria, Abuja, Central Bank of Nigeria, Abuja and Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: How do Macroeconomic Conditions affect Banks’ Performance in Nigeria?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Authors have no conflicting interest to declear
declarations.ethicsApproval: All ethical rules for standard research have been followed, including appropriate citations.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for the study

detail.abstract: This study examines how macroeconomic conditions influence Nigerian banks' performance, focusing on loan quality, profitability, and capital adequacy. Using quarterly data from 2010Q3 to 2025Q1, we apply a nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag (NARDL) framework to capture short-run and long-run asymmetries. The results show that macroeconomic shocks affect banks in asymmetric and time-dependent ways. GDP expansions reduce non-performing loans and support profitability but weaken capital adequacy by inflating risk-weighted assets, while contractions depress profitability and solvency. Inflation has mixed effects: moderate inflation boosts earnings through loan repricing, but sustained price pressures increase credit risk and erode capital buffers, while disinflation compresses margins. Exchange rate depreciation, modelled symmetrically, raises defaults and reduces solvency in the long run but has a transitory impact on profitability. The paper offers clear policy lessons: the need for countercyclical capital buffers to mitigate procyclical credit risks, the importance of inflation stabilisation as a foundation for financial soundness, and the necessity of active exchange rate risk management to reduce systemic exposure.

title: Branching Out: Capital Mobility and Long-Run Growth
affiliations: Vanderbilt University and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Branching Out: Capital Mobility and Long-Run Growth
detail.abstract:
We study the long-run effects of the first wave of U.S. banking market integration on capital mobility and manufacturing productivity. Using newly digitized bank and branch balance sheet data matched to state and county panels, we provide direct evidence that branching produced lasting productivity gains without aggregate capital deepening by leveraging internal capital markets to improve the geographic allocation of capital. Our novel ``deposit market access'' measure shows that bank funding grew most in capital-constrained counties within branching states. Both market access and border discontinuity designs indicate that branching’s organizational structure reduced capital allocation frictions to generate persistent growth.

title: Echoes of Waste: The Realities Behind RA 9003

detail.title: Echoes of Waste: The Realities Behind RA 9003
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the implementation of Republic Act 9003, or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, through an analysis of three studies conducted in Cabuyao City, Barangay Pansol of Quezon City, and a nationwide policy assessment by the Philippine Institute for Development Studies (PIDS). The critique identifies both the strengths and limitations of these studies in addressing the local application of solid waste management policies. The findings highlight that while the law establishes a strong framework for sustainable waste management, challenges such as weak enforcement, inadequate facilities, limited funding, and low public awareness persist. The paper also discusses the importance of community engagement, institutional coordination, and behavioral change in enhancing policy effectiveness. Recommendations are proposed to strengthen local implementation through measurable performance indicators, public-private partnerships, and continuous education programs. Ultimately, this critique underscores that successful solid waste management requires more than compliance—it demands shared responsibility, sustained governance, and active citizen participation

title: The Economic Impact of Brexit
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, Bank of England, King’s College London - King's Business School, Deutsche Bundesbank and University of Nottingham

detail.title: The Economic Impact of Brexit
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the impact of the UK's decision to leave the European Union (Brexit) in 2016. Using almost a decade of data since the referendum, we combine simulations based on macro data with estimates derived from micro data collected through our Decision Maker Panel survey. These estimates suggest that by 2025, Brexit had reduced UK GDP by 6% to 8%, with the impact accumulating gradually over time. We estimate that investment was reduced by between 12% and 18%, employment by 3% to 4% and productivity by 3% to 4%. These large negative impacts reflect a combination of elevated uncertainty, reduced demand, diverted management time, and increased misallocation of resources from a protracted Brexit process. Comparing these with contemporary forecasts – providing a rare macro example to complement the burgeoning micro-literature of social science predictions – shows that these forecasts were accurate over a 5-year horizon, but they underestimated the impact over a decade.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Revisiting Female Headship and Multidimensional Poverty: Insights from the Nicaraguan Context
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Revisiting Female Headship and Multidimensional Poverty: Insights from the Nicaraguan Context

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.

detail.abstract:
This paper reexplores the assumption that female-headed households (FHH) often experience
lower standards of living compared to male-headed households (MHH) by addressing three of the gaps
found in the literature i) it uses a multidimensional poverty measure (MPI-LA); ii) employs objective
definitions for female headship based on economic and demographic characteristics; and iii) accounts for
household structure. Using cross-sectional data from the Nicaraguan Living Standards Measurement Study
(LSMS) 2014, the results indicate that FHH have lower levels of general poverty than MHH, regardless of
the headship definition used. However, differences in multidimensional poverty exist within FHH according
to the household structure. Co-resident MHH presents the highest multidimensional poverty levels, as
opposed to de facto FHH, which are found the least disadvantaged of all groups. Differences in severe
poverty are not as clear as those found in general poverty. A better measurement of household headship and
poverty can lead to better focalisation of poverty reduction programmes.

AI.tldr: 本文重新探讨女性户主家庭比男性户主家庭生活水平更低的假设，使用多维贫困指标和客观的户主定义，发现女性户主家庭总体贫困水平更低，但多维贫困因家庭结构而异。
AI.research_question: 女性户主家庭是否真的比男性户主家庭经历更低的生活水平？

title: Restrictive Marriage Migration Policies and Family Outcomes
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago - Department of Economics and University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Restrictive Marriage Migration Policies and Family Outcomes
detail.abstract:
As cross-border marriages rise, many governments have tightened rules on who can marry across borders, often in the name of promoting integration. Cross-border couples tend to have high divorce rates, which hinders successful assimilation. This paper provides the first evidence on how restrictive marriage migration policies affect family outcomes of migrants. We exploit a 2014 reform in South Korea that introduced pre-entry requirements for marriage visas, with language proficiency as the key component. Using rich administrative and survey data, we show that the reform led to a sharp temporary decline in cross-border marriages, improved migrants’ language skills, and increased educational attainment among both migrants and their Korean spouses. Comparing marriage cohorts immediately before and after the reform cutoff date, we find that cumulative divorce rates fell by 37% in the first 12 months and by 12% in the first 48 months, primarily due to language-based selection rather than demographic factors. Our evidence indicates that improved communication enhanced marital surplus and highlights the potential positive impact of selective admission policies that target civil and cultural assimilation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 韩国2014年婚姻签证改革引入语言能力要求，导致跨境婚姻暂时减少，但提高了移民语言能力和教育水平，离婚率显著下降，主要归因于语言筛选而非人口因素。

AI.method: 利用韩国2014年婚姻签证改革作为自然实验，使用行政和调查数据，比较改革前后婚姻队列

title: Organizational Identification and Managerial Myopia:Evidence from R&D Investment
affiliations: California State University, Long Beach, affiliation not provided to SSRN and California State University, Long Beach

detail.title: Organizational Identification and Managerial Myopia:Evidence from R&D Investment
detail.abstract: This study examines whether CEO organizational identification (OI) influences firms’ propensity to engage in myopic research and development (R&D) cuts. Using an archival-based measure of CEO OI, we find a negative association between CEO OI and the likelihood of reducing R&D expenditures to just meet analyst earnings forecasts. This result is consistent with the view that CEOs who strongly identify with their organizations are less willing to jeopardize innovation and long-term competitiveness for short-term performance. Cross-sectional analyses show that the negative relation is stronger in firms with greater innovation output but weaker when dedicated institutional ownership is higher. The findings remain robust when using alternative research designs to address endogeneity and to a placebo test that replaces R&D with capital investment. This study contributes to the literature by highlighting the role of CEO psychological orientation, measured using archival data, in shaping costly earnings management through myopic investment behavior.

AI.tldr: CEO组织认同度越高，企业越不可能为了达到分析师盈利预测而削减研发支出，这种关系在创新产出高的企业中更强，但在机构持股比例高时减弱。
AI.research_question: CEO组织认同是否影响企业进行短视研发削减的倾向？

AI.method: 使用基于档案数据的CEO组织认同度量，采用横截面分析和替代研究设计处理内生性问题，并进行安慰剂检验

title: The Sovereign Greenium: Big Promise but Small Price Effect
affiliations: Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies (IHEID) - Department of Economics, University of Geneva - Graduate Institute, Geneva (IHEID),  and University of Virginia School of Law

detail.title: The Sovereign Greenium: Big Promise but Small Price Effect

publicationDetails.detailsText: Virginia Public Law and Legal Theory Research Paper No. 2025-76
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Virginia Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Virginia Law and Economics Research Paper No. 2025-23
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Virginia Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the existence, magnitude and drivers of the sovereign greenium: the yield discount on sovereign and quasi-sovereign green bonds relative to conventional bonds. Using a dataset of 332 matched pairs of green and conventional bonds issued between 2014 and 2023 by sovereigns, sovereign-backed agencies, and multilateral development institutions, we analyze secondary-market pricing to capture both crosssectional and time-varying heterogeneity. We find a small but statistically significant greenium, averaging about 2 basis points for advanced economies and nearly 13 basis points for emerging markets. The greenium is larger for lower-rated issuers and increases when climate transition risks become more salient or when issuers are more vulnerable to climate change. Interaction effects indicate that global awareness of transition risks and domestic climate vulnerability jointly amplify the greenium. While green sovereign bonds trade at lower yields, the resulting fiscal savings are economically modest relative to total interest expenditures. A novel analysis of bond documentation shows that sovereign green bonds contain no binding commitments regarding environmental outcomes, suggesting that the observed greenium reflects symbolic rather than contractual sustainability value.

AI.tldr: 研究发现主权绿色债券存在小幅但显著的"绿色溢价"（greenium），即绿色债券相对于传统债券的收益率折价。发达经济体平均约2个基点，新兴市场约13个基点。绿色溢价在评级较低、气候转型风险突出或气候脆弱性较高的发行人中更大，且反映了象征性而非契约性的可持续价值。
AI.research_question: 主权绿色债券是否存在收益率折价（绿色溢价）？其规模、驱动因素和性质是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着绿色债券市场快速发展，理解绿色债券定价机制及其可持续性价值对政策制定者和投资者至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债券定价理论，结合气候风险感知和可持续投资偏好理论。
AI.method: 使用2014-2023年间332对匹配的绿色与传统债券的二级市场定价数据，进行横截面和时变异质性分析。
AI.findings: 存在统计显著的绿色溢价：发达经济体约2个基点，新兴市场约13个基点；绿色溢价在低评级发行人、气候转型风险突出或气候脆弱性高的发行人中更大；全球转型风险认知与国内气候脆弱性共同放大绿色溢价；债券文件分析显示绿色债券不含具有约束力的环境承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了绿色溢价的驱动机制，特别是气候风险感知与投资者偏好的交互作用；区分了象征性价值与契约性价值在绿色债券定价中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了绿色债券定价的实证依据；帮助投资者理解绿色溢价的来源和局限性；表明当前绿色债券的财政节约效应相对有限。

detail.abstract: Meeting expectations? Assessing the Savings and Investment Union (SIU) communication against the recommendations of Draghi, Letta and Noyer The European Commission's communication on the Savings and Investments Union (SIU) follows the highprofile reports by Draghi, Letta and Noyer, which together have shaped expectations for integrating financial markets to support the wider EU economy. This briefing analyses the SIU communication with the three reports in mind as reference points. The briefing is structured in accordance with the main sections of the SIU communication, with a concluding section at the end.

title: Monetary Policy (Interest Rates) Announcements: A Case Study on Banking and Non-Banking Stocks in India
affiliations: REVA Business School (RBS), REVA University and REVA University - REVA Business School

detail.title: Monetary Policy (Interest Rates) Announcements: A Case Study on Banking and Non-Banking Stocks in India
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) repo rate announcements on stock performance by analyzing abnormal returns (AR), average abnormal returns (AAR), and cumulative average abnormal returns (CAAR) across banking and nonbanking sectors during the period from 2022 to 2025. The banking sector sample comprises twelve private sector banks and twelve public sector banks, while the non-banking segment includes twenty-three non-banking BSE SENSEX constituent companies. The study considers nine monetary policy announcements made by the RBI during this period, classified into three categories-repo rate increases, decreases, and no-change decisions-with a total of 423 observations. Using the event study methodology, expected returns were estimated over a 252day estimation window, and a twenty-one-day event window (ten days before and ten days after the event) was applied for both AAR and CAAR calculations. The findings reveal that private banks exhibited stronger and more favourable market reactions compared to public banks and non-banking firms, reflecting asymmetric investor sentiment and varied responses to different repo rate decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过事件研究法分析印度央行回购利率公告对银行和非银行部门股票表现的影响，发现私人银行比国有银行和非银行公司表现出更强、更有利的市场反应。
AI.research_question: 印度央行回购利率公告对银行和非银行部门股票表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解货币政策公告对不同类型金融机构股票市场反应的差异，帮助投资者和政策制定者理解市场对利率变化的敏感度。

AI.findings: 私人银行相比国有银行和非银行公司表现出更强、更有利的市场反应，反映了投资者情绪的不对称性和对不同回购利率决策的差异化响应
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了货币政策传导机制理论，揭示了不同类型金融机构对利率变化的差异化市场反应

title: The Emergence of a Data Winter: The Growing Enclosure of Data at a Time of Rapid AI Advances
affiliations: The GovLab

detail.title: The Emergence of a Data Winter: The Growing Enclosure of Data at a Time of Rapid AI Advances
detail.abstract: We are entering a data winter-a period marked by the growing inaccessibility of data critical for science, governance, and innovation. Just as previous AI winters saw stagnation in artificial intelligence research, today's data winter is characterized by the enclosure of data behind proprietary, regulatory, and technological barriers. This contraction threatens the capacity for evidence-based policymaking, scientific discovery, and equitable AI development at a moment when data has become society's most strategic resource. Eight interrelated forces are driving this decline: government open data cutbacks, shifting institutional priorities toward risk aversion, generative AI-induced data hoarding, research data lockdowns, scarcity of high-quality training data, risks of synthetic data substitution, geopolitical fragmentation, and private-sector closure. Together, these trends risk immobilizing data that could otherwise serve the public good. To counteract this trajectory, the paper proposes five strategic interventions: (1) shifting norms and incentives to treat data as essential infrastructure; (2) translating openness commitments into enforceable action; (3) investing in professional data stewardship across sectors; (4) advancing governance innovations such as digital self-determination and social license mechanisms to restore trust; and (5) developing sustainable data commons as shared infrastructures for equitable reuse. The technical means exist, but the collective 1 will is uncertain. The paper concludes by arguing that the coming years will determine whether society builds an open, collaborative data ecosystem-or succumbs to a fragmented, privatized data order.

AI.tldr: 论文警告我们正进入"数据寒冬"时期，关键数据被封闭在专有、监管和技术壁垒之后，威胁科学、治理和创新。提出了五个战略干预措施来应对这一趋势。
AI.research_question: 如何应对当前数据可及性下降的危机，即"数据寒冬"现象？
AI.motivation: 数据作为社会最重要战略资源，其可及性下降威胁到循证决策、科学发现和公平AI发展，需要紧急应对措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据基础设施、数据治理、数字自决和社会许可等理论框架。
AI.method: 分析性论文，识别八个驱动数据可及性下降的相互关联因素，并提出应对策略。
AI.findings: 识别出政府开放数据削减、机构风险规避、生成AI引发的数据囤积、研究数据封锁、高质量训练数据稀缺、合成数据替代风险、地缘政治碎片化、私营部门封闭等八个驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"数据寒冬"概念框架，扩展了数据治理理论，强调数据作为公共基础设施的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了五个具体战略干预措施：将数据视为基础设施、将开放承诺转化为可执行行动、投资专业数据管理、推进治理创新、发展可持续数据公地。

title: A Post-COVID Macroprudential Framework for Climate Risk Stress Testing in the Banking Sector
affiliations: The University of Lahore Islamabad Campus

detail.title: A Post-COVID Macroprudential Framework for Climate Risk Stress Testing in the Banking Sector
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has revealed critical vulnerabilities in the global financial system, prompting the need for a more resilient macroprudential architecture. Concurrently, climate change continues to pose complex, long-term, and uncertain systemic risks. This study develops a comprehensive post-COVID macroprudential framework for climate risk stress testing (CRST) in the banking sector, integrating real data from 2019 to 2025 across central European and American banks. By incorporating pandemic-induced shocks and climate transition pathways, the framework simulates dual-risk scenarios to assess bank-level solvency, credit losses, and systemic contagion.The proposed framework utilizes a multi-model approach, combining NGFS climate scenarios, System-GMM, Panel VAR, Credit Portfolio Models (CPM), Climate Value-at-Risk (VAR), DSGE simulation, and Network Contagion Models. Empirical results show that banks with higher carbon exposure and weaker pre-COVID capital buffers experienced amplified losses under compounded stress events. Furthermore, network-based contagion effects reveal significant cross-border vulnerabilities, especially within the European interbank market.The findings underscore the importance of integrating pandemic risks into climate stress testing and call for enhanced macroprudential tools such as climate-specific capital buffers, ESG-aligned disclosure requirements, and countercyclical regulatory interventions. This paper contributes to the growing body of climate-finance literature by offering a practical, data-driven framework to guide policymakers, regulators, and financial institutions in strengthening systemic resilience amid converging global crises.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个后疫情时代的宏观审慎气候风险压力测试框架，整合了疫情冲击和气候转型路径，通过多模型方法评估银行偿付能力、信贷损失和系统性传染风险。研究发现高碳暴露和弱资本缓冲的银行在复合压力事件中损失更大，呼吁加强气候特定资本缓冲等宏观审慎工具。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个综合的宏观审慎框架来评估疫情和气候变化双重风险对银行体系的影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情揭示了全球金融系统的脆弱性，同时气候变化带来复杂、长期且不确定的系统性风险，需要更稳健的宏观审慎架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎监管理论、气候金融理论、系统性风险理论、网络传染理论
AI.method: 多模型方法：NGFS气候情景、System-GMM、Panel VAR、信贷组合模型、气候VaR、DSGE模拟、网络传染模型，使用2019-2025年中欧和美洲银行真实数据
AI.findings: 高碳暴露和疫情前资本缓冲较弱的银行在复合压力事件中损失更大；网络传染效应显示显著的跨境脆弱性，特别是在欧洲银行间市场
AI.theory_contributions: 将疫情风险整合到气候压力测试中，扩展了气候金融文献；提供了评估双重风险的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构和金融机构提供了实用的数据驱动框架，建议实施气候特定资本缓冲、ESG披露要求和逆周期监管干预

title:
Simplification, Not Deregulation?

Unpacking the Debate on Simplification and Regulatory Burden for European Banks
affiliations: and European Parliament

detail.title:
Simplification, Not Deregulation?

Unpacking the Debate on Simplification and Regulatory Burden for European Banks
detail.abstract: The cost of banking regulation and the supervisory framework for banks feature prominently in the debate over EU competitiveness. The strong regulation and supervision implemented after the great financial crisis are generally considered a positive for the EU economy, but in the context of the notion of simplification, a discussion is ongoing whether cost reduction is possible without deregulation. To support parliamentary scrutiny of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM), this briefing analyses:-the interaction of simplicity and deregulation;-the ongoing simplification efforts of the ECB / SSM and the European Commission; and the demands of stakeholders for simplification.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟银行业监管成本与简化监管框架之间的平衡问题，探讨了在不放松监管的前提下降低成本的可行性，并评估了欧洲央行、单一监管机制和欧盟委员会的简化努力以及利益相关者的需求。
AI.research_question: 在保持严格监管的同时，欧盟银行业监管框架能否实现成本降低和简化？
AI.motivation: 欧盟竞争力辩论中银行业监管成本和监管框架的重要性日益凸显，需要在不放松监管的前提下探索简化可能性以支持议会监督。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管成本效益分析、监管简化理论、银行监管框架评估
AI.method: 政策文件分析、利益相关者需求评估、监管措施比较分析
AI.findings: 简化与放松监管之间存在复杂互动关系，当前ECB/SSM和欧盟委员会已开展简化努力，但利益相关者对进一步简化有持续需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对监管简化与放松监管概念区分的理论理解，为监管框架优化提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟议会监督单一监管机制提供决策支持，为银行业监管框架的简化改革提供实践指导。

title: Passive Flows, Index Rebalancing, and Price Impact: Evidence from a Quasi-Experiment in Hong Kong
affiliations: University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: Passive Flows, Index Rebalancing, and Price Impact: Evidence from a Quasi-Experiment in Hong Kong
detail.abstract: This paper exploits a unique feature of the Hong Kong Hang Seng Index (HSI)-a weight cap-to examine the price impact of index rebalancing and passive fund flows. Under the index's design, the weight of any constituent stock exceeding a specified threshold must be reduced, with the excess weight redistributed among other constituents. Passive funds tracking the index are therefore required to rebalance their portfolios each quarter to mirror these adjustments. These information-free flows are estimated to induce a 0.6% decline in the abnormal returns of stocks subject to mandatory weight reductions. Using an instrumental variable approach, I estimate the price elasticity of demand for Hong Kong mega-cap stocks to be approximately-0.25. The findings suggest that asset demand is relatively inelastic and provide additional evidence consistent with a downward-sloping demand curve for equities.

AI.tldr: 本文利用香港恒生指数的权重上限特征，研究了指数再平衡和被动基金流动的价格影响。研究发现，因权重限制而被强制减仓的股票会出现0.6%的异常收益下降，香港大盘股的需求价格弹性约为-0.25，表明资产需求相对缺乏弹性。
AI.research_question: 指数再平衡和被动基金流动对股票价格有何影响？香港大盘股的需求价格弹性是多少？
AI.motivation: 利用香港恒生指数独特的权重上限设计，可以识别信息无关的被动基金流动，从而更准确地估计股票需求的价格弹性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向下倾斜的股票需求曲线理论、资产定价理论、被动投资对市场价格影响的理论
AI.method: 利用香港恒生指数的权重上限作为自然实验，采用工具变量方法估计价格弹性
AI.findings: 因权重限制被强制减仓的股票出现0.6%的异常收益下降；香港大盘股的需求价格弹性约为-0.25
AI.theory_contributions: 为股票需求曲线向下倾斜提供了新的实证证据；证实了资产需求相对缺乏弹性
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解指数再平衡的价格影响提供参考；对被动基金管理人的投资决策具有指导意义

title: Love Thy Neighbor - Reducing Driving through Green Slot Labels in E-Commerce
affiliations: and Institute of Transport Economics

detail.title: Love Thy Neighbor - Reducing Driving through Green Slot Labels in E-Commerce

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Research Council of Norway under the projects "VOM: Incentives for Measures for Food System Transition", Grant No. 319892, and “CarNudge”, Grant No. 300625.

detail.abstract: Love thy neighbor-reducing driving through green slot labels in e-commerce A crucial aspect of corporate social responsibility and green consumerism is whether consumers wish to make sustainable choices and are willing to pay a premium for green goods and services. In the context of e-commerce, delivering products to consumers is a significant factor when discussing its sustainability. With the rapid growth of e-commerce and its related negative externalities, there is an emerging literature on the potential of nudging consumers towards more environmentally friendly delivery options. We contribute to this literature by exploring a quasi-natural experiment of green labeling, investigating revealed preference data from 35,828 Norwegian customers over almost five weeks in 2024. A green label was used on time slots to optimize the route planning, thereby minimizing driving and related externalities. We exploit the quasi-random property of the assignment mechanism of green labels, and a pricing randomized control trial, to estimate the effect of the label and the willingness to pay for green delivery. We assess the impact of the green label on the probability of a customer choosing a greener alternative by estimating a multinomial logit model. Results show that the probability of choosing a slot more than doubles when labeled as green. Moreover, we find a willingness to pay of € 1 for green delivery, ultimately suggesting that consumers value green services and that green labeling is an effective tool for online retailers to minimize delivery costs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过准自然实验研究电商配送中的绿色标签对消费者选择的影响，发现绿色标签使消费者选择环保配送时段的概率增加一倍以上，消费者愿意为绿色配送支付1欧元的溢价。
AI.research_question: 绿色标签如何影响消费者在电商配送中的选择行为？消费者是否愿意为环保配送支付溢价？
AI.motivation: 随着电商快速增长及其负面外部性，需要探索如何引导消费者选择更环保的配送选项，这是企业社会责任和绿色消费主义的重要方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的助推理论，通过绿色标签这种轻推方式影响消费者决策。
AI.method: 准自然实验设计，利用35,828名挪威消费者近5周的显示偏好数据，结合定价随机对照试验，采用多项logit模型估计绿色标签的影响。
AI.findings: 绿色标签使消费者选择环保配送时段的概率增加一倍以上；消费者愿意为绿色配送支付1欧元的溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色标签在电商配送中的有效性提供了实证证据，扩展了助推理论在可持续消费领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明绿色标签是电商零售商降低配送成本的有效工具，为实践中的可持续配送策略提供了指导。

title: Cats, Dogs, and Babies: Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Substitutes or Complements from Linked Administrative Records
affiliations: National Taiwan University, National Taiwan University - Department of Economics, National Taiwan University and University of Rochester

detail.title: Cats, Dogs, and Babies: Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Substitutes or Complements from Linked Administrative Records
detail.abstract:
Falling fertility is one of the most pressing demographic and economic challenges of the twenty-first century, particularly in East Asia. Among the many popular explanations, the rise of companion animals has captured public imagination, often portrayed as substitutes for children or as complements in family formation. Yet, despite this widespread narrative, systematic evidence remains scarce. This paper provides the first large-scale empirical analysis combining individual-level administrative data and quasi-experimental methods to examine the relationship between pet ownership and childbearing. We link Taiwan’s universe of pet registry records with administrative tax files, constructing a ten-year panel covering 23 million individuals and millions of registered cats and dogs.

Our analysis proceeds in three steps. First, we document descriptive patterns: pet ownership peaks in the twenties while childbearing peaks later, and cross-sectional correlations differ by species: dogs are positively associated with children, cats negatively. Second, we estimate substitution elasticities. Exploiting the staggered rollout of child bonuses, we find that dog ownership rises by 21% following a birth, yielding a Marshallian cross-price elasticity of−1.32. Using lottery winnings to isolate income effects, we estimate a Hicksian elasticity of−1.29, confirming that children and pets are net complements. Third, event studies show that adopting a dog raises the probability of subsequent childbearing by 33%, consistent with a “practice child” mechanism, while childbirth reduces later pet adoption.

These findings expand the economics of fertility by introducing pets as a previously overlooked determinant of household decisions. They also reveal that pro-natalist policies affect not only fertility itself but related choices such as pet acquisition, broadening our understanding of modern family economics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合台湾宠物登记记录和税务数据，首次大规模实证分析了宠物所有权与生育之间的关系。研究发现狗与孩子是互补品而非替代品，养狗会提高后续生育概率33%，支持"练习孩子"机制。
AI.research_question: 宠物所有权与生育行为之间的关系是什么？宠物是孩子的替代品还是互补品？
AI.motivation: 生育率下降是21世纪最紧迫的人口经济挑战之一，特别是在东亚地区。尽管宠物作为孩子替代品或家庭形成补充的流行说法广为流传，但系统性证据仍然匮乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭经济学、生育决策理论、替代品与互补品理论
AI.method: 结合个体层面行政数据（宠物登记记录和税务文件）和准实验方法，构建十年面板数据，覆盖2300万个体和数百万注册猫狗。采用交错式儿童津贴推出和彩票中奖作为外生冲击。
AI.findings: 1. 描述性模式：宠物所有权在20多岁达到高峰，生育高峰较晚；横截面相关性因物种而异：狗与孩子正相关，猫与孩子负相关。2. 替代弹性：狗所有权在生育后上升21%，马歇尔交叉价格弹性为-1.32，希克斯弹性为-1.29，确认孩子与宠物是净互补品。3. 事件研究：收养狗使后续生育概率提高33%，支持"练习孩子"机制，而生育会减少后续宠物收养。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过引入宠物作为先前被忽视的家庭决策决定因素，扩展了生育经济学。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示亲生育政策不仅影响生育本身，还影响相关选择如宠物获取，拓宽了对现代家庭经济学的理解。

title: Trump 2.0 Tariff Policies  (Türkiye's Trade Elasticities and Potential Tendencies)

detail.title: Trump 2.0 Tariff Policies  (Türkiye's Trade Elasticities and Potential Tendencies)

contentType.other: Istanbul University, Faculty of Economics Türkiye and Europe and Middle Eastern Economic Relations Reseach Center, working paper series, 1, September 2025

contentFormat.other: Istanbul University, Faculty of Economics Türkiye and Europe and Middle Eastern Economic Relations Reseach Center, working paper series, 1, September 2025

detail.abstract: This paper examines the potential effects of the new tariff policies announced during the Trump 2.0 era on global trade and their possible consequences for Türkiye. The paper first summarizes the basic framework of discussions about the potential global effects of tariff policies. These discussions suggest that changes in tariff policies specific to Türkiye could impact relations beyond Türkiye-USA. The study analyzes the potential effects of tariff policies on Türkiye based on elasticity estimates. The trend in the elasticities of exports and imports with Türkiye’s main trading partners, the USA, Germany, and China, over time is estimated using the rolling regression method. It is concluded that during the period 1994-2024, the real effective exchange rate effect on Türkiye’s foreign trade was weak, while changes in the income levels of the relevant countries had a more decisive impact. In addition, it is determined that exports of textiles, machinery, metals, and ores, which account for a significant share of exports to the USA, have different dimensions. Possible tariff changes could affect all three commodity groups to varying degrees, as supported by the rolling regression results covering the period 1994-2022. The findings reveal that, although Türkiye will be among the countries with low exposure to Trump 2.0 policies, the indirect effects of tariff changes will be more decisive. Therefore, Türkiye's trade with Germany and China, the nature of its GVCs(Global Value Chains) integration, and its capacity to maintain competitive conditions during this process are highlighted as important determinants.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了特朗普2.0时代关税政策对全球贸易的潜在影响，特别关注土耳其的情况。研究发现虽然土耳其直接受政策影响较小，但间接效应更为关键，特别是与德国和中国的贸易关系、全球价值链整合程度以及维持竞争力的能力。
AI.research_question: 特朗普2.0时代的关税政策对全球贸易的潜在影响及其对土耳其的后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 分析新关税政策对全球贸易格局的影响，特别关注土耳其作为新兴经济体的应对策略和风险暴露程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于弹性估计的贸易理论，采用滚动回归方法分析贸易弹性变化，结合全球价值链理论框架。
AI.method: 使用滚动回归方法估计1994-2024年间土耳其与主要贸易伙伴（美国、德国、中国）的进出口弹性趋势。
AI.findings: 1994-2024年间实际有效汇率对土耳其外贸影响较弱，而相关国家收入水平变化影响更大；纺织品、机械、金属等出口商品组受影响程度不同；土耳其直接政策暴露度低但间接效应显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴经济体在贸易政策变化中的风险暴露机制理解，扩展了全球价值链整合对贸易政策传导效应的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者提供应对贸易政策变化的策略建议，强调与德国和中国的贸易关系、全球价值链整合和竞争力维持的重要性。

title: Sovereign Debt Restructuring Mechanisms: Trends, Tools, and Global Case Studies
affiliations: State Scientific Research Institute for Informatization and Economic Modeling

detail.title: Sovereign Debt Restructuring Mechanisms: Trends, Tools, and Global Case Studies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economic journal of Lesya Ukrainka Volyn National University, volume 3, issue 43, 2025[10.29038/2786-4618-2025-03-36-43]

detail.abstract:
Introduction. In Ukraine, the debt crisis has intensified, manifested in the growth of public liabilities, an expanding budget deficit, and increasing pressure on public finances. Limited domestic funding sources compel the state to actively borrow on the debt market, exceeding safe limits and heightening insolvency risks. Under these conditions, debt restructuring emerges as a key tool to prevent financial destabilization. Global experience provides insights into effective mechanisms that can be adapted to Ukraine’s realities to restore debt sustainability. The purpose of the study is to outline the key principles for implementing sovereign debt restructuring mechanisms, with a focus on global experience, to develop recommendations for their successful application in Ukraine.
Methods. The study is based on official statistical data from Ukraine and international financial institutions, scientific publications, analytical reports, and examples of global debt restructuring cases. Methods of analysis and synthesis, comparative and statistical analysis, graphical methods, and the case study approach were employed to identify trends and assess the effectiveness of debt mechanisms.
Results. The necessity of restructuring as a key tool for stabilizing public finances has been substantiated. The effectiveness of restructuring mechanisms has been shown to depend on the depth of changes to debt conditions and coordination with creditors. Emphasis has been placed on the role of comprehensive reforms and fiscal consolidation. A comparison of global cases of successful and unsuccessful restructurings has been conducted. The main tools and approaches to their implementation have been systematized. The conclusion has been drawn on the advisability of adapting the best international practices to Ukraine’s conditions.
Conclusions. Sovereign debt restructuring is a crucial tool for reducing debt burden and restoring financial stability, but its effectiveness depends on a comprehensive approach, coordination with creditors, and accompanying economic reforms. Global experience highlights the advisability of combining various mechanisms and implementing innovative tools. For Ukraine, the key lies in adapting the best international practices to national conditions and maintaining systematic dialogue with creditors to enhance debt sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了乌克兰债务危机，探讨了主权债务重组作为稳定公共财政的关键工具，基于全球经验提出了适用于乌克兰的重组机制实施原则和建议。
AI.research_question: 如何基于全球经验实施主权债务重组机制，为乌克兰制定有效的债务重组策略？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰债务危机加剧，公共负债增长、预算赤字扩大、公共财政压力增加，国内融资来源有限迫使国家在债务市场积极借贷，超过安全限度并加剧了破产风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务重组理论、债务可持续性理论、财政稳定理论
AI.method: 基于乌克兰和国际金融机构的官方统计数据、科学出版物、分析报告和全球债务重组案例，采用分析和综合方法、比较和统计分析、图形方法和案例研究方法。
AI.findings: 重组作为稳定公共财政的关键工具是必要的；重组机制的有效性取决于债务条件改变的深度和与债权人的协调；需要强调全面改革和财政整顿的作用；比较了全球成功和失败的重组案例；系统化了主要工具和实施方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化了主权债务重组的理论框架，提出了债务重组机制有效性的关键影响因素，丰富了债务可持续性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰提供了基于全球经验的主权债务重组实施建议，包括机制选择、债权人协调策略和配套改革措施，有助于提升乌克兰的债务可持续性。

title: On the Employment and Budget Consequences of Delayed Work Authorization for U.S. Asylum Seekers

detail.title: On the Employment and Budget Consequences of Delayed Work Authorization for U.S. Asylum Seekers
detail.abstract: Asylum applicants to the United States of America face a statutory 180-day wait for initial employment authorization, delaying formal job search and shifting support needs onto municipalities. Evidence from Europe indicates that longer waits depress early employment and earnings, yet U.S.-specific estimates are scarce. We build a continuous-time search model calibrated to quasi-experimental elasticities from Switzerland (employment) and Sweden (earnings), combine it with current U.S. labor and cost data, and simulate counterfactual reforms—0-, 30-, and 90-day waits—against the 180-day status quo. The model translates earlier work access into job-months, wage mass, payroll tax timing, and reduced shelter days, with Monte Carlo uncertainty that propagates the Swiss employment estimate, separation hazards, wages, and per-diems. We find shortening wait meaningfully accelerates entry into work (double-digit percentage-point employment gains within a year), pulls forward measurable wage income and payroll receipts, and yields sizable per-person reductions in shelter expenditures under the modeled assumptions. Scaled to large cohorts, impacts are economically and fiscally material: thousands of additional job-months per 1,000 entrants; city-level savings in the hundreds of millions; and national savings in the billions. These magnitudes are robust to alternative earnings intensity and cost assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国庇护申请者180天工作许可等待期的影响，通过构建搜索模型模拟缩短等待期的改革效果，发现缩短等待期能显著加速就业、增加工资收入和税收，并大幅减少庇护支出。
AI.research_question: 缩短庇护申请者的工作许可等待期对就业、收入和公共支出的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国庇护申请者面临180天工作许可等待期，这延迟了正式就业并将支持需求转移到市政当局，而美国本土的实证研究缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间搜索模型，校准了来自瑞士（就业）和瑞典（收入）的准实验弹性估计
AI.method: 构建搜索模型，结合美国当前劳动力和成本数据，模拟0天、30天和90天等待期的反事实改革，使用蒙特卡洛方法处理不确定性
AI.findings: 缩短等待期能显著加速就业（一年内就业率提升两位数百分点），提前工资收入和税收，大幅减少庇护支出；按大规模群体计算，影响在经济和财政上都很显著
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了美国背景下庇护申请者工作许可等待期影响的量化估计，填补了美国特定实证研究的空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了缩短等待期改革的经济和财政收益证据，支持更快的就业整合政策

title: Student Debt (Forgiveness) in General Equilibrium

detail.title: Student Debt (Forgiveness) in General Equilibrium
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the Biden Administration's proposed student loan forgiveness policy in a stochastic overlapping generations model with 60 periods of life and three household types differentiated by student debt-to-income ratios. The central finding is that student loan forgiveness generates minimal real economic effects, contradicting the policy's stated objective of promoting wealth accumulation among over-leveraged borrowers. Despite reduced debt burdens, borrowers allocate the transfer primarily toward consumption rather than retirement savings or productive investment, leaving aggregate capital, production, wages, and asset prices virtually unchanged. For non-borrowers, the policy delivers welfare losses driven almost entirely by higher tax obligations needed to finance the forgiveness, with negligible offsetting gains from general equilibrium spillovers. While forgiveness does provide a small welfare benefit through reduced consumption risk-acting as government-provided intergenerational risk sharing-this effect is quantitatively minor. The results suggest that student loan obligations were not the binding constraint on wealth accumulation for young highly leveraged borrowers, and the forgiveness program operates primarily as a fiscal transfer rather than a mechanism to unlock productive investment.

detail.abstract: This comment recommends the delineation of criteria for a voluntary heightened standard for privacy in compliant decentralized payment systems. title:

A Report of the LEO Policy Working Group

detail.title:
Low Earth Orbit Satellites: Policies to Promote Spectrum Sharing, Foster Competition, and Close Digital Divides:
A Report of the LEO Policy Working Group

declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: Paper was supported by the New America Foundation and the International Center for Law & Economics

detail.abstract:
Recent advances in technology have dramatically expanded the potential for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to meet global connectivity needs. Satellites in orbit have grown tenfold over the past decade. LEO systems can now deliver faster speeds and lower latency than previous generations, enabling services ranging from broadband internet and remote backhaul to sensing networks and enterprise IoT.

This report by the LEO Policy Working Group highlights three salient LEO issues for policymakers to address. First, effective spectrum sharing and coexistence reforms can hugely expand LEO capacity, performance, and innovation. The report endorses a new U.S.-led framework for satellite spectrum sharing, higher power, and a dramatic increase in allocations for both fixed and mobile satellite use. Second, the report finds that competition is real and intensifying but also skewed by state sponsorship and regulatory asymmetries. Policymakers must remain alert to how vertical integration, tying, and merger activity shape the market over time. Third, LEO systems are advancing the goal of universal connectivity, but traditional government subsidy programs need to be adjusted to better incorporate them. Policymakers must consider LEO service’s strengths, challenges, and use cases to effectively include LEO systems in ongoing and future broadband subsidy programs.

title: The Cost of Caring: Gendered Health and Labour Market Effects of Grandparenthood
affiliations: Norwegian Institute of Public Health - Centre for Fertility and Health, Norwegian Institute of Public Health, Norwegian Institute of Public Health - Centre for Fertility and Health, University College London and Norwegian Institute of Public Health - Centre for Fertility and Health

detail.title: The Cost of Caring: Gendered Health and Labour Market Effects of Grandparenthood

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the Regional Committees for Medical and Health Research Ethics (REK) in Norway (#2018/434).
declarations.funderStatement: This study is part of the PARMENT project and was funded by the Research Council of Norway (#334093). This work was partly supported by the Research Council of Norway through its Centres of Excellence funding scheme, project number 262700 and co-funded by the European Union (ERC, BIOSFER, 101071773).

detail.abstract: While the effects of the transition to parenthood are well-researched, less is known about how the transition to grandparenthood affects health and labour market outcomes. Using comprehensive Norwegian register data covering the entire population born between 1950 and 1960, we examine the effects of firstborn grandchildren born during 2007-2018. Employing event-study models with person-year records, we compare grandparents to not-yet grandparents. Our findings reveal a sharp increase in the likelihood of respiratory infections during the first two years of grandparenthood, with infections increasing by 56% for women and 31% for men. Additionally, grandparenthood modestly reduces the likelihood of doctor's visits related to mental disorders (4.5%) and cardiovascular health (3.3%). Grandmothers also see a decline in musculoskeletal-related visits (3.8%). These health-related changes coincide with notable gendered effects on labour market participation. Ten years after the birth of their first grandchild, employed women are 12% less likely to hold full-time positions compared to a 2% reduction for men. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the transition to grandparenthood significantly reshapes health and economic outcomes for both women and men. The larger effects observed for women likely reflect their greater involvement in informal childcare provision. Our results underscore the intersection of health, family dynamics, and gendered labour market behaviours in late adulthood.

title: Charitable Pledges and Deductible Hedges: Estate and Gift Tax Uncertainty and Charitable Giving

detail.title: Charitable Pledges and Deductible Hedges: Estate and Gift Tax Uncertainty and Charitable Giving
detail.abstract: This paper examines how charitable giving responds to an unexpected and transitory increase in the federal estate and gift tax exemption using nonprofit-level data. I document an asymmetric response among nonprofits types, with private foundations responding much more strongly to the reform than public charities. Within private foundations, those funded by individuals or individual-like entities such as trusts and pass-throughs drive the observed giving response rather than corporate foundations. An analysis of donor-advised funds yields similar results. Together, these patterns suggest that the rise in giving is due to estate and gift tax avoidance as a hedge against future uncertainty in tax policy. Furthermore, these charitable gifts coincide with a large increase in intergenerational transfers, indicating that the timing of charitable giving is similar to that of taxable transfers. These findings highlight the role of long-term tax planning in behavioral responses to tax policy by the wealthy, and they have broad implications for both our understanding of tax avoidance at the top of the income and wealth distributions and for the provision of public goods.

title: International PCAOB Inspections and the Decline in Foreign Listings to the United States
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, University of Texas at Austin and

detail.title: International PCAOB Inspections and the Decline in Foreign Listings to the United States
detail.abstract: Foreign listings in the United States (U.S.) have fallen sharply over the past two decades. Using the staggered introduction of Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) inspection access in 55 countries, we test whether the regulator’s expanding global oversight contributed to this decline. Our stacked difference-in-differences estimates show that foreign firms are significantly less likely to pursue U.S. listings when doing so subjects their audits to PCAOB inspection. This deterrent effect comes from a drop in new listings on major exchanges, not from over-the-counter listings or deregistrations. The effect is strongest for (1) firms facing higher compliance costs of inspections, (2) industries likely viewed as strategically sensitive by foreign governments, and (3) countries with greater political tension with the U.S. Placebo tests show no similar decline in non-U.S. listings after PCAOB access; in fact, listings in some foreign markets rise, consistent with substitution away from U.S. exchanges.

title: Allocating the Cost of Town Walls in Medieval Castile: A Rabbinic Analysis
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Allocating the Cost of Town Walls in Medieval Castile: A Rabbinic Analysis
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the normative criteria proposed by Rabbi Maeir Halevi Abulafia (Ramah) for allocating the cost of building urban fortifications among Jewish aljamas in medieval Castile. Using textual and historical-interpretive analyses of rabbinic sources, this paper maintains that Ramah's extensive cost allocation analysis of town walls was driven by historical events surrounding the Reconquista. The paper finds that Ramah's geometric cost allocation scheme is consistent with both Talmudic and economic efficiency reasoning. Because the Talmudic letter of the law conflicted with equity considerations, the Ramah was forced to do an "about face" and rationalize a more equitable approach, if only by reference to less-than-ideal Talmudic sources. This study contributes to the historical accounting literature by showing that cost allocation in medieval Spain was justified both on efficiency and equity grounds-albeit moderated by historical exigencies-in consonance with some of the modern cost allocation literature.

title: Does Childcare Cost Women More? A Study of the Gender Income Gap in Pakistan
affiliations: University College Dublin and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Does Childcare Cost Women More? A Study of the Gender Income Gap in Pakistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 819

detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic costs of caregiving for women in Pakistan, with a focus on the caregiving wage penalty and its variation across the wage distribution and between urban and rural contexts. Using nationally representative data from the Pakistan Social and Living Standards Measurement Survey 2019–2020, the analysis combines Propensity Score Matching (PSM), Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), Recentered Influence Function (RIF) regressions, and RIF–Oaxaca decompositions. PSM estimates indicate that female caregivers earn approximately 44% less than comparable non-caregivers, while OLS results confirm a penalty of around 48%. Extending the analysis to the intensive margin, each additional child is associated with a wage reduction of approximately 12%, although the effect diminishes with increasing family size. The presence of a young child (aged 0–6) results in a significant penalty, whereas the presence of older children does not affect earnings. RIF–OLS estimates reveal that penalties are not uniform: at the 10th quantile, caregivers earn 67%–73% less than noncaregivers, with the gap narrowing to about 21%–28% at the 90th quantile. The RIF– Oaxaca decomposition highlights a persistent rural disadvantage, with total rural–urban caregiving gaps ranging from 16% to 24%, driven by both weaker endowments (lower schooling and agricultural employment) and lower returns to those characteristics. These findings demonstrate that caregiving responsibilities impose a substantial and unequal wage penalty on women, with the heaviest burden falling on low-income and rural mothers.

title: Exit Routes: Entrepreneurial Governance Imprints and Scaling Paths in SPACs and IPOs
affiliations: University of Groningen

detail.title: Exit Routes: Entrepreneurial Governance Imprints and Scaling Paths in SPACs and IPOs
detail.abstract: I examine how the choice of going public via SPACs versus IPOs imprints governance and shapes entrepreneurial scaling. Using a matched sample of 569 SPAC mergers and 1,242 IPOs between 2016 and 2023, I provide the first large-sample comparison of post-listing governance and outcomes. SPAC boards are smaller, less diverse, and less industry-connected than IPO boards, retain founder-CEOs at much higher rates and experience lower CEO turnover. While CEO pay levels are similar across routes, these governance differences map into distinct scaling pathways. IPO firms, with more professionalized boards, form more alliances, establish them faster, and are more likely to engage in technology partnerships. SPAC firms, by contrast, pursue innovation-led growth, filing more patents and announcing more products, particularly when founders remain as CEOs. SPACs also exhibit modestly weaker compliance but no greater litigation risk. These results highlight governance-driven trade-offs in how entrepreneurial ventures grow after going public.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了通过SPAC上市与IPO上市对公司治理和创业扩张的影响，发现SPAC公司董事会规模更小、多样性更低、行业联系更少，但更倾向于保留创始人CEO，导致不同的增长路径：IPO公司更注重联盟和技术合作，SPAC公司更注重创新和产品开发。
AI.research_question: SPAC上市与IPO上市如何影响公司治理结构并塑造创业企业的扩张路径？
AI.motivation: 随着SPAC上市方式的流行，需要系统比较SPAC与IPO两种上市路径对公司治理和后续发展的影响差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论、创业企业成长理论和上市路径选择理论。
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年569个SPAC并购和1,242个IPO的匹配样本进行大样本比较分析。
AI.findings: SPAC董事会规模更小、多样性更低、行业联系更少，但创始人CEO保留率更高；IPO公司更注重联盟和技术合作，SPAC公司更注重专利和产品创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同上市路径对公司治理的印记效应，以及治理结构如何塑造创业企业的不同增长路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业企业选择上市路径提供决策参考，帮助理解不同上市方式对后续发展的长期影响。

title: Long-Term Debt and the Effect of a Money-financed Fiscal Stimulus
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and

detail.title: Long-Term Debt and the Effect of a Money-financed Fiscal Stimulus
detail.abstract: This paper examines money-financed fiscal stimulus in a New Keynesian model with long-term debt, highlighting the roles of fiscal shock persistence, debt maturity, and the policy rule implementing money financing. Under a strict debt-targeting rule, longer maturities amplify stimulus when shocks are short-lived but dampen it when shocks are persistent. Strikingly, for empirically relevant maturities and persistence, money-financed stimulus can be less effective than debt-financed stimulus. These patterns persist at the zero lower bound, though sensitivity to maturity is weaker. Finally, directly targeting money growth yields large and robust multipliers, rendering money financing more stimulative than debt financing.

AI.tldr: 本文在具有长期债务的新凯恩斯模型中研究了货币融资的财政刺激，重点分析了财政冲击持续性、债务期限和实施货币融资的政策规则的作用。研究发现，在严格的债务目标规则下，较长期限在冲击短暂时放大刺激效果，但在冲击持续时削弱刺激效果。对于实证相关的期限和持续性，货币融资刺激可能比债务融资刺激效果更差。这些模式在零利率下限时仍然存在，但对期限的敏感性较弱。直接以货币增长为目标能产生大而稳健的乘数，使货币融资比债务融资更具刺激效果。
AI.research_question: 货币融资的财政刺激在不同债务期限、财政冲击持续性和政策规则下的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 理解货币融资财政刺激的有效性及其对经济政策制定的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯模型，长期债务框架
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，比较不同政策规则下的刺激效果
AI.findings: 1. 在严格债务目标规则下，债务期限对刺激效果的影响取决于冲击持续性；2. 对于实证相关的参数，货币融资刺激可能不如债务融资有效；3. 在零利率下限时模式类似但敏感性减弱；4. 直接以货币增长为目标能产生更强且更稳健的刺激效果
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了新凯恩斯模型中的货币融资财政刺激理论，明确了债务期限和冲击持续性在政策效果中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于货币融资财政刺激有效性的重要洞见，建议直接以货币增长为目标可能比传统方法更有效

detail.abstract: We examine when and why institutional investors engage portfolio firms on ESG issues using proprietary engagement records from a European asset manager. Salient negative incidents emerge as a powerful trigger—second only to firm size—because they heighten reputational accountability for investors and reveal new information about hidden ESG weaknesses, particularly at firms perceived as ESG leaders. Monitoring also extends along the supply chain: incidents at key suppliers prompt investor engagement with focal firms. Finally, engagement is associated with higher firm value, stronger ESG performance, and increased cash flows. Together, the findings illuminate the drivers and mechanisms of ESG engagement and underscore its role as an effective channel of external corporate governance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，机构投资者在负面ESG事件发生后更倾向于参与公司治理，这种参与能提升公司价值、改善ESG表现并增加现金流。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者何时以及为何会就ESG问题参与投资组合公司的治理？
AI.motivation: 理解机构投资者ESG参与行为的驱动因素和机制，以及这种参与作为外部公司治理渠道的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于声誉问责理论和信息不对称理论，探讨负面事件如何触发投资者参与。
AI.method: 使用欧洲资产管理公司的专有参与记录数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 负面事件是仅次于公司规模的强大触发因素；监控延伸至供应链；参与带来公司价值提升、ESG表现改善和现金流增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了ESG参与的驱动因素和机制，特别是负面事件在触发投资者参与中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了ESG参与策略的实证依据，证明ESG参与是有效的公司治理渠道。

detail.abstract: We develop a novel, scalable method for assessing the quality of public procurement systems using standard administrative data. Our approach compares the distribution of procurement opportunities to the distribution of contract awards across firms. We first derive a simple theoretical benchmark that relates the expected distribution of contract value winning firms, measured as a Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI), to the distribution of auction values, measured as a respective HHI, and the number of winning firms. Significant deviations of winning firms' HHI from this benchmark indicate potential governance failures such as corruption or unchecked collusion. Our method requires no subjective input, is transparent and reproducible, and allows for meaningful comparisons across countries, industry sectors, and over time. We use procurement data from Ukraine and EU member states in 2018-2021 to assess the performance of five large sectors. Results indicate that Ukraine's procurement performance in four of the five sectors is comparable to many other European countries. However, Ukraine's construction sector consistently displays the largest excess concentration among all countries considered, consistent with anecdotal evidence of corruption in this sector. Overall, with minimal data requirements, our method offers a practical tool for cross-sector and cross-country assessment of procurement systems.

AI.tldr: 开发了一种使用行政数据评估公共采购系统质量的新方法，通过比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布的差异来识别治理失败。该方法无需主观输入，透明可复制，适用于跨国跨行业比较。
AI.research_question: 如何利用标准行政数据客观评估公共采购系统的质量？
AI.motivation: 需要一种透明、可复制且无需主观输入的公共采购系统评估方法，以便进行跨国跨行业比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拍卖理论，建立采购机会分布与合同授予分布之间的理论基准关系，使用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数(HHI)衡量集中度。
AI.method: 比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布的差异，使用HHI指数衡量集中度，分析实际HHI与理论基准的偏差。
AI.findings: 乌克兰在五个大型行业中，四个行业的采购表现与许多欧洲国家相当，但建筑行业在所有国家中显示出最大的过度集中，与腐败传闻一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于行政数据的公共采购系统评估理论框架，建立了采购机会与合同授予分布关系的理论基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用的跨部门跨国采购系统评估工具，数据需求最小，可用于识别腐败和串通等治理失败问题。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the extent to which Health Technology Assessment (HTA) might have influenced health system performance in terms of healthcare cost performance, employment in health and social care, and mortality outcomes. By comprehensive descriptive and causal analyses combining Difference-in-Differences (DiD) with an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression model. The research examines short-term as well as long-term effects of HTA implementation. The findings suggest that HTA uptake is linked to meaningful, sustained mortality reductions for myocardial infarction and ischemic stroke over the long term and short term, suggesting improvements in clinical quality and population health. While short-term effects on cost performance and employment are limited, the long-term analysis suggests that HTA contributes to reducing costs and resource optimization as technologies mature within health systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过双重差分法和OLS回归模型分析健康技术评估(HTA)对医疗系统绩效的影响。研究发现HTA实施在长期和短期都能显著降低心肌梗死和缺血性中风的死亡率，长期来看还有助于降低成本和优化资源配置。
AI.research_question: 健康技术评估(HTA)在多大程度上影响了医疗系统绩效，包括医疗成本绩效、健康和社会护理就业以及死亡率结果？
AI.motivation: 评估HTA对医疗系统绩效的实际影响，为政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康技术评估理论、医疗系统绩效评估框架
AI.method: 结合双重差分法(DiD)和普通最小二乘法(OLS)回归模型的综合描述性和因果分析
AI.findings: HTA实施与心肌梗死和缺血性中风死亡率的显著持续降低相关；短期对成本绩效和就业影响有限，但长期有助于降低成本和优化资源配置
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了HTA对医疗系统绩效影响的实证证据，完善了健康技术评估理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为HTA政策制定提供决策支持，证明HTA在改善临床质量和人口健康方面的长期价值

title: Spending Composition and Fiscal Consolidation: Enhancing Resilience in the Face of Economic Shocks
affiliations: European Stability Mechanism, European Stability Mechanism, European Stability Mechanism and European Stability Mechanism

detail.title: Spending Composition and Fiscal Consolidation: Enhancing Resilience in the Face of Economic Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 73
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the aftermath of recent shocks, including the Covid-19 pandemic, energy crisis and a changing geopolitical landscape, many European countries face high debt and increased uncertainty. A key policy question is whether euro area member states can effectively implement successful consolidation plans. This paper explores how the initial composition of public spending – particularly the share of rigid expenditure such as pensions and public wages – affects a government’s ability to implement successful fiscal consolidation strategies in response to shocks. Drawing on past fiscal adjustment episodes, we develop a formal framework to assess how ex-ante fiscal conditions shape consolidation outcomes. Our analysis reveals that high share of a rigid spending significantly limits governments’ flexibility, resulting in more pronounced cuts to investment and other more flexible expenditure categories. This leads to deeper GDP contractions, slower recoveries, and less successful debt reduction in high-rigidity environments. In contrast, countries with more flexible spending structures experience more balanced expenditure cuts, resulting in more effective consolidations and greater resilience. Our findings suggest that proactive fiscal planning, including gradual shifts toward more flexible spending composition, can enhance fiscal resilience and improve the likelihood of a successful fiscal consolidation. The study offers important policy implications for governments seeking to navigate fiscal distress and long-term challenges such as ageing populations and the green transition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，公共支出中刚性支出（如养老金和公共工资）比例较高的国家，在实施财政整顿时会面临更大困难，导致更严重的GDP收缩和更慢的复苏。相反，支出结构更灵活的国家能够实现更有效的财政整顿。
AI.research_question: 公共支出的初始构成（特别是刚性支出比例）如何影响政府实施成功财政整顿策略的能力？
AI.motivation: 在新冠疫情、能源危机和地缘政治变化等冲击后，许多欧洲国家面临高债务和不确定性，需要评估欧元区成员国能否有效实施财政整顿计划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于过去财政调整经验建立的正式分析框架，评估事前财政条件如何影响整顿结果。
AI.method: 基于历史财政调整案例的正式框架分析
AI.findings: 高刚性支出比例显著限制政府灵活性，导致投资和其他灵活支出类别更大幅度削减，造成更深的GDP收缩、更慢的复苏和更不成功的债务削减。支出结构灵活的国家则能实现更平衡的支出削减和更有效的整顿。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了公共支出构成与财政整顿效果之间的理论联系，揭示了刚性支出对财政灵活性的限制机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政府通过逐步转向更灵活的支出结构来增强财政韧性，提高财政整顿成功的可能性，为应对人口老龄化和绿色转型等长期挑战提供政策指导。

title: Interest Rates and Pension Fund Risk-Taking: New Cross-Country Evidence
affiliations: Imperial College Business School

detail.title: Interest Rates and Pension Fund Risk-Taking: New Cross-Country Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of low interest rates on pension fund risk-taking. I assemble a new cross-country dataset encompassing portfolio holdings of over 100 large pension funds. The data reveal that pension funds increased their exposure to riskier asset classes, such as equities and alternatives, in the low interest rate period after the global financial crisis. Using an instrumental variables approach, I estimate that pension funds increase their exposure to risky assets when domestic interest rates fall. A 25 basis point decline in interest rates is associated with a 0.51 percentage point increase in pension funds' share of risky assets. This behavior is most pronounced for mature and underfunded pension funds, facing greater pressure to generate returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，低利率环境促使养老基金增加对风险资产的投资，特别是成熟和资金不足的养老基金更倾向于承担更高风险。
AI.research_question: 低利率对养老基金风险承担行为的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机后持续的低利率环境对养老基金投资策略的影响需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合理论和风险承担动机理论。
AI.method: 使用工具变量方法分析100多家大型养老基金的投资组合数据。
AI.findings: 利率下降25个基点，养老基金风险资产配置比例增加0.51个百分点；成熟和资金不足的基金风险承担行为更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解机构投资者在低利率环境下的风险承担行为提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为养老基金监管和政策制定提供了实证依据，有助于评估低利率环境下的金融稳定风险。

title: Automation and Employment Recovery after the Great Recession
affiliations: Ashoka University,  and Ashoka University

detail.title: Automation and Employment Recovery after the Great Recession
detail.abstract: We study how automation shapes employment dynamics over the business cycle. We find that U.S. regions with higher pre-Great Recession exposure to automation experienced significantly faster employment recoveries after the recession, conditional on identical initial shocks. To explain this result, we develop a model of firm heterogeneity with automation investment subject to cash flow constraints. The model predicts a faster employment recovery in more automated regions following a transitory negative TFP shock. Firms in these regions are automation capital intensive, allowing them to better withstand both the adverse impact of the shock as well as the dampening role of the investment constraint along the recovery path. As a result, these regions benefit from the complementarity between automation capital and labour, leading to a faster employment recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在经历相同初始冲击的情况下，自动化程度较高的美国地区在大衰退后就业恢复速度更快。作者构建了一个包含自动化投资和现金流约束的企业异质性模型来解释这一现象。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何影响商业周期中的就业动态？
AI.motivation: 理解自动化在就业恢复过程中的作用，特别是在经济衰退后的复苏阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业异质性模型，包含自动化投资和现金流约束，强调自动化资本与劳动力的互补性。
AI.method: 实证分析美国地区数据，结合理论模型构建和数值模拟。
AI.findings: 自动化程度较高的地区在大衰退后就业恢复速度显著更快，这归因于自动化资本密集型企业能够更好地应对冲击和投资约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含自动化投资和现金流约束的企业异质性模型，解释了自动化在就业恢复中的积极作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于自动化投资在促进就业恢复方面的重要见解，有助于制定更有效的经济复苏政策。
