detail.abstract: We show experimentally that a very brief face-to-face conversation, or small talk, with a potential trading partner can serve a contracting function by enhancing trust and strengthening cooperative norms. Specifically, subjects engaged in three-minute video calls with no agenda before playing Hold Up and Stag Hunt games. Despite having no prior knowledge of the games, the calls positively impacted trust, cooperation, and efficiency: there was more investment and less stealing in the Hold Up games, and the twice-repeated Stag Hunt games more frequently resulted in the efficient equilibrium. Our findings suggest that some players who have the opportunity to hold up others change their preferences, and some who risk being held up change their beliefs. Beyond indicating that small talk can alleviate contractual incompleteness, the results may also explain its use in other settings.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，3分钟的无议程视频通话（闲聊）能够增强信任和合作规范，在Hold Up和Stag Hunt游戏中显著提高投资、减少偷窃行为，并促进高效均衡的实现。
AI.research_question: 简短的面谈或闲聊是否能够通过增强信任和合作规范来发挥契约功能？
AI.motivation: 探讨非正式社交互动（如闲聊）在缓解契约不完全性方面的作用，解释其在各种场景中的广泛应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 契约不完全性理论、信任与合作规范理论、行为博弈论
AI.method: 实验方法：让受试者在玩Hold Up和Stag Hunt游戏前进行3分钟无议程视频通话，观察通话对信任、合作和效率的影响。
AI.findings: 视频通话显著提高了信任和合作水平：Hold Up游戏中投资增加、偷窃减少；Stag Hunt游戏中更频繁达到高效均衡。一些玩家改变了偏好，另一些改变了信念。
AI.theory_contributions: 为契约不完全性理论提供了行为证据，扩展了非正式互动在契约执行中的作用机制理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理、商业谈判等场景中利用简短社交互动来增强合作提供了实践指导，解释了闲聊在现实中的功能性价值。

detail.abstract: Until the mid-20th century, tangible assets were the primary drivers of economic growth. However, with the rise of digital transformation and the Fourth Industrial Revolution, the role of intangible assets has grown significantly in the 21st century. Traditional forms of intangible assets—such as software, R&D, branding, intellectual property rights, design, and organizational capital—have become central to enhancing firm-level and macroeconomic competitiveness. More recently, advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), big data, and cloud computing are emerging as new forms of intangible capital that contribute to innovation, productivity, and growth. Against this backdrop, this report analyzes the role of intangible asset investment in both major economies and Korea, and provides policy insights by examining its relationship with key economic indicators such as growth, productivity, and firm performance. detail.abstract: When the economic crisis struck financial and other funding markets in mid-2007, ECB introduced new non-standard monetary policy measures to calm down capital markets, stimulate real economic activity and boost credit growth. These new tools, launched by other major central banks, were a turning point in global monetary policy, having significantly led to the recovery of the global economic system. This paper provides a chronology of the ECB's non-standard tools and discusses related literature. Eurozone substantially benefited from non-conventional measures, but the impact of these measures was weaker for the member states that were more affected by the economic crisis and faced fiscal problems.

title: Comparative Analysis of Hedging Effectiveness in Emerging and Developed Markets in Asia
affiliations: Nottingham University Business School and Nottingham University Business School, Malaysia Campus

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Hedging Effectiveness in Emerging and Developed Markets in Asia
detail.abstract: Purpose-This study evaluates the comparative hedging effectiveness of equity index futures across five Asian market, including Malaysia (FKLI), Indonesia (FMID), Hong Kong (HSIF), Singapore (SSGF), and Japan (NK225) during the period of 2018 to 2024. It determines whether developed markets systematically deliver higher effectiveness than emerging markets. Besides, it has analysed how optimal hedge ratios and variance reduction evolve across pre-COVID (2018-2019), COVID (2020-2021), and post-COVID (2022-2024) regimes. Moreover, is has studied the performance across different modelling class such as OLS, VAR/VECM, and DVEC_MGARCH once cointegration and time-varying covariance are considered. Design/ Methodology/Approach-Using daily spot and near-month futures data, we estimate optimal hedge ratios (OHR) via: (1) static OLS regressions of spot on futures returns; (2) dynamic VAR models, or VECM where Johansen tests indicate cointegration; and (3) a bivariate DVEC-MGARCH(1,1) to capture conditional variances and covariance, producing time-varying OHR. Hedging effectiveness (HE) is measured by Ederington's variance-reduction metric and corroborated with R 2. Diagnostics include residual autocorrelation, ARCH effects, stability checks, and MGARCH positivity/stationarity constraints. Findings-Developed markets (Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan) consistently achieve nearcomplete variance reduction (HE > 90%) with OHR in 0.90 to 0.99 range. Malaysia exhibits meaningful convergence after 2021, reaching ~ 91% hedging effectiveness by 2024, while Indonesia remains lower (HE≈41-65%) owing to persistent basis risk and liquidity frictions. Where cointegration is present (Malaysia 2018/2024, Japan 2022), VECM outperforms VAR. DVEC-MGARCH improves performance during turbulent periods (2020-2021) by adapting to volatility clustering and time-varying covariance, narrowing the emerging-market gap. Originality/Value-The paper delivers a unified, multi-model, multi-country comparison for Asian equity index futures with explicit regime segmentation around COVID-19. By juxtaposing OLS, VAR/VECM, and DVEC-MGARCH within a consistent framework, it clarifies when dynamic and cointegration-aware strategies deliver material gains over static hedges, especially in less liquid markets. Research Limitations/Implications-Results reflect near-month futures and do not explicitly model transaction costs, roll slippage, or margin-induced constraints. Market microstructure effects and intraday lead-lag dynamics are not separately identified. Practical Implications-Risk managers in developed Asian markets can rely on parsimonious hedges with stable, high HE. In emerging markets, dynamic strategies (VECM when cointegrated; DVEC-MGARCH in high-volatility regimes) enhance variance reduction and capital efficiency. Exchanges and regulators can further compress basis risk by deepening liquidity and transparency.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了五个亚洲市场（马来西亚、印度尼西亚、香港、新加坡、日本）股指期货在2018-2024年期间的套期保值有效性，发现发达市场（新加坡、香港、日本）的套期保值有效性接近完全（>90%），而新兴市场（马来西亚、印度尼西亚）有效性较低。研究还分析了COVID-19前后不同时期的套期保值比率变化，并比较了OLS、VAR/VECM和DVEC-MGARCH三种模型的性能。
AI.research_question: 发达市场的股指期货套期保值有效性是否系统性地高于新兴市场？不同时期（COVID-19前后）和不同模型（OLS、VAR/VECM、DVEC-MGARCH）如何影响套期保值有效性？
AI.motivation: 评估亚洲不同发展水平市场的股指期货套期保值表现，为风险管理提供实证依据，特别是在COVID-19等市场动荡时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于套期保值理论，使用Ederington方差减少指标衡量套期保值有效性，考虑协整关系和时间变化协方差对套期保值比率的影响。
AI.method: 使用每日现货和近月期货数据，通过OLS回归、VAR/VECM模型（考虑协整关系）和DVEC-MGARCH(1,1)模型估计最优套期保值比率，并进行残差自相关、ARCH效应等诊断检验。
AI.findings: 发达市场套期保值有效性超过90%，新兴市场较低（马来西亚约91%，印度尼西亚41-65%）；存在协整关系时VECM优于VAR；DVEC-MGARCH在动荡时期表现更好；马来西亚在2021年后有效性显著提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了亚洲市场多模型、多国家的统一比较框架，明确了动态策略和协整感知策略在何时优于静态套期保值，特别是在流动性较差的市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 发达市场的风险管理者可使用简洁的套期保值策略，新兴市场应采用动态策略（存在协整时用VECM，高波动时期用DVEC-MGARCH）来提高资本效率。交易所和监管机构可通过提高流动性和透明度来减少基差风险。

title: Revisiting Wallersteiner V Moir and the New Playbook for Nigerian Buyouts
affiliations: Victoria Chambers

detail.title: Revisiting Wallersteiner V Moir and the New Playbook for Nigerian Buyouts
detail.abstract: This article explores the legal and financial architecture of leveraged buyouts (LBOs) in Nigeria, against the backdrop of the seminal English case Wallersteiner v Moir and Section 183 of the Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA) 2020. While Nigeria's corporate landscape is experiencing a wave of mergers and acquisitions, private equity sponsors remain limited in their ability to execute LBOs due to statutory restrictions on financial assistance. Drawing parallels with the UK's regulatory evolution, particularly the repeal of financial assistance rules for private companies under the Companies Act 2006, the article revisits the cautionary lessons of Wallersteiner, maps out modern LBO structures using SPVs and commercial paper vehicles, and applies these to the Nigerian context. Through an examination of the landmark Darktrace take-private transaction, the paper highlights practical strategies for lawful LBO execution in Nigeria using timing-sensitive structuring. It further proposes a calibrated reform of Section 183, one that preserves creditor protection while enabling flexibility and innovation in acquisition finance. Ultimately, the article provides a practical playbook for legal advisers, private equity sponsors, and regulators seeking to reconcile LBO sophistication with Nigerian corporate law compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚杠杆收购的法律与金融架构，分析《公司法》第183条对金融援助的限制，借鉴英国监管改革经验，提出符合尼日利亚法律环境的LBO执行策略和立法改革建议。
AI.research_question: 如何在尼日利亚现行公司法限制下合法执行杠杆收购，以及如何改革相关法规以促进收购融资创新？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚并购活动增加但私募股权机构因金融援助限制难以执行LBO，需要探索合规的LBO结构和法律改革路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Wallersteiner v Moir判例原则和金融援助理论，结合SPV和商业票据工具等现代LBO结构理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法（英国与尼日利亚监管对比）、案例研究法（Darktrace交易分析）、法律条文分析法。
AI.findings: 通过时间敏感的结构设计和SPV工具可在尼日利亚现行法律下合法执行LBO；第183条需要平衡债权人保护与融资灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了金融援助规则在发展中国家并购环境中的应用理论，提出了适应尼日利亚法律环境的LBO执行框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律顾问和私募股权机构提供尼日利亚LBO合规操作指南，为监管机构提出具体的法律改革建议。

title: Structured Multiplicative, Recursive Systems in Financial Markets
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structured Multiplicative, Recursive Systems in Financial Markets
detail.abstract: Market Resonance Theory (MRT) reinterprets financial markets as structured multiplicative, recursive systems rather than linear, dollar-based constructs. By mapping price growth as a logarithmic lattice of intervals, MRT identifies the deep structural cycles underlying long-term market behaviour. The model draws inspiration from the proportional relationships found in musical resonance, specifically the equal temperament system, revealing that markets expand through recurring octaves of compounded growth. This framework reframes volatility, not as noise, but as part of a larger self-organising structure.

AI.tldr: 市场共振理论将金融市场重新解释为结构化乘性递归系统，通过映射价格增长的对数区间晶格，识别长期市场行为的深层结构周期。
AI.research_question: 金融市场是否存在深层的结构性周期？如何重新解释市场波动和增长模式？
AI.motivation: 传统线性、美元基础的金融模型无法充分解释市场的长期行为和结构性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场共振理论，基于音乐共振中的比例关系，特别是等律音阶系统。
AI.method: 将价格增长映射为对数区间晶格，识别市场扩展的复合增长八度循环。
AI.findings: 市场通过重复的复合增长八度进行扩展，波动是更大自组织结构的一部分而非噪音。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了重新解释金融市场作为结构化乘性递归系统的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解长期市场行为和结构性周期提供了新的分析工具和视角。

title: The Deadlock Consequences in Ethiopia
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Deadlock Consequences in Ethiopia
detail.abstract: The Horn of Africa—comprising Ethiopia, Eritrea, Djibouti, and Somalia—stands as one of the most historically, culturally, and biologically significant regions of the African continent. Spanning over 3 million years of human evolutionary history, Ethiopia in particular is a cradle of human development, marked by critical archaeological discoveries such as Lucy (Australopithecus afarensis) and other hominin fossils. This evolutionary significance provides an unparalleled empirical foundation for understanding humanity, yet the contemporary social, political, and humanitarian landscape of the region presents a stark contrast to this ancient heritage.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了非洲之角地区（埃塞俄比亚、厄立特里亚、吉布提和索马里）在人类进化史上的重要性与其当代社会政治现实的对比。
AI.research_question: 非洲之角地区作为人类进化摇篮的历史意义如何与其当代社会政治挑战形成对比？
AI.motivation: 该地区拥有超过300万年的人类进化历史，特别是埃塞俄比亚发现了露西等关键考古发现，但当代却面临严重的社会政治和人道主义问题，这种对比值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类进化理论、考古学和当代政治社会学理论框架
AI.method: 文献综述和历史比较分析
AI.findings: 非洲之角地区在人类进化史上具有无与伦比的重要性，但其当代现实与这一丰富遗产形成鲜明对比
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对人类进化历史与当代社会发展关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解该地区的发展挑战提供了历史背景，有助于制定更有效的区域发展策略

title: Assessing the Impacts of the COVID-19 Outbreak on MSCI Classified Countries' Stock Markets
affiliations: NED University of Engineering and Technology, NED University of Engineering and Technology, Pace University, NED University of Engineering and Technology and NED University of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Assessing the Impacts of the COVID-19 Outbreak on MSCI Classified Countries' Stock Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests with other people or organizations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or personal data; therefore, ethical approval and participant consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or clinical interventions.

detail.abstract: COVID-19 plummeted the global financial markets including stock, bond, and commodity markets (including crude oil and gold) resulting in great financial loss. The COVID-19 recession caused severe damage to the global economy, and finance has been severely disrupted. Identifying this recession could be the basis of our current study. How the COVID-19 epidemic affected the financial markets, what mostly influenced the fluctuation, which country had the greatest depression, and how it stabilised the situation in the face of these significant obstacles. That study emphasized the stock market and commodity market taking no. of cases of COVID-19 and phases of lockdown that occurred in these countries. The majority of the enterprises' supply chains were, to put it mildly, severely stressed during the COVID-19 issue. It was difficult to develop any sane short-term plans because issues ranging from the purchase of goods and raw materials to transportation to the production site and delivery, without forgetting the human element, had to be controlled on a daily basis. Our motivation to conduct this study is to offer investors, industrialists and the government a general view of how the health crisis affected our economy by fluctuating stock and commodity markets. This will help them better analyze the situation if unfortunately, another outbreak occurs. Our concern is also to analyze how this pandemic affected the global economy and to provide a basis for further studies. This study looked at how COVID19 affected the stock and commodity markets across the various lockdown periods. To achieve our objective, we applied Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test to check the stationary of our variables, following the results, we used time series models, the conventional Welch test on the stock return, gold indices, and oil prices. The research is based on the seven countries’ data given by the MSCI country classification. COVID19 has undoubtedly wreaked havoc on the global economy. We conducted research on the impact of COVID-19 on the stock and commodity markets of MSCI categorized nations in order to assess COVID-19's impact. We've gathered all of the information we needed and created a graphical depiction of it. Our upcoming effort will include putting the tests we outlined earlier to use and concluding our analysis and writing a report at the end. Our research looked at the influence of COVID -19 on the stock and commodity markets, particularly crude oil and gold, in MSCI nations. We divided the world into developed and, emerging countries classified by MSCI. If another pandemic or health crisis strikes in the near future, our research will assist governments and investors in analyzing the impact of a health catastrophe on the global economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了COVID-19疫情对MSCI分类国家（包括发达和新兴市场）的股票和商品市场（特别是原油和黄金）的影响，重点关注不同封锁阶段的市场波动，旨在为投资者、工业界和政府提供应对未来健康危机的参考。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情如何影响金融市场的波动？哪些因素主要影响了波动？哪些国家受影响最严重？以及各国如何应对这些重大障碍来稳定局势？
AI.motivation: 为投资者、工业界和政府提供健康危机如何通过影响股票和商品市场波动来影响经济的整体视图，帮助他们在不幸发生另一次疫情时更好地分析情况，并为后续研究提供基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于MSCI国家分类框架，将世界分为发达国家和新兴市场国家，分析疫情对不同类型经济体的差异化影响。
AI.method: 应用增强迪基-富勒检验检查变量的平稳性，随后使用时间序列模型和传统的Welch检验对股票回报、黄金指数和石油价格进行分析，基于MSCI分类的七个国家数据。
AI.findings: COVID-19无疑对全球经济造成了严重破坏，研究通过收集所需信息并创建图形描述来评估其影响（具体测试结果和结论将在后续工作中完成）。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了健康危机与金融市场波动的关联分析框架，为理解疫情等突发公共卫生事件对经济的影响提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究成果将帮助政府和投资者在未来发生类似疫情或健康危机时，分析健康灾难对全球经济的影响，制定更有效的应对策略。

title: Cultural Participation in the Digital Era: Evidence from the China Household Cultural Consumption Survey
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Cultural Participation in the Digital Era: Evidence from the China Household Cultural Consumption Survey
detail.abstract: The advent of digitalisation has fundamentally reshaped everyday life, altering how we communicate, interact, consume, and engage in leisure activities. Using data from the China Household Cultural Consumption Survey, this study examines how people’s digital engagement shapes their cultural participation and well-being. We develop an Individual Digitalisation Index to measure digital engagement and analyse cultural participation across four dimensions: consumption, time allocation, diversity, and content creation. Our analysis reveals three key findings. First, higher digital engagement correlates with increased cultural participation across all dimensions. Second, among these four dimensions, only the diversity of participation – rather than consumption volume or time allocation – demonstrates a significant positive effect on well-being. Third, digital engagement amplifies the positive effect of participation diversity on well-being by facilitating access to more diverse cultural experiences. These findings contribute to our understanding of the role of digital economy in facilitating access to cultural activities and its broader implications for societal well-being.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过中国家庭文化消费调查数据，探讨数字参与如何影响文化参与和幸福感。研究发现：数字参与度越高，文化参与越广泛；只有文化参与的多样性（而非消费量或时间分配）对幸福感有显著正向影响；数字参与通过促进获取更多样化的文化体验，增强了参与多样性对幸福感的积极影响。
AI.research_question: 数字参与如何影响人们的文化参与和幸福感？
AI.motivation: 数字化从根本上重塑了日常生活，改变了人们的沟通、互动、消费和休闲活动方式，需要研究这种变化对文化参与和幸福感的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个体数字化指数、文化参与的四个维度（消费、时间分配、多样性、内容创作）、幸福感理论
AI.method: 使用中国家庭文化消费调查数据，构建个体数字化指数来衡量数字参与度，分析文化参与的四个维度。
AI.findings: 1. 数字参与度越高，文化参与越广泛；2. 只有文化参与的多样性对幸福感有显著正向影响；3. 数字参与增强了参与多样性对幸福感的积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数字经济在促进文化活动获取中作用的理解，及其对社会幸福感的更广泛影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过数字化促进文化多样性和提升社会幸福感的实证依据。

title: The Adaptive Evolution of Capitalism: State Strategic Guidance in the Digital Age

detail.title: The Adaptive Evolution of Capitalism: State Strategic Guidance in the Digital Age

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The liberal international order is undergoing a reconfiguration, not collapse, as advanced economies adapt to the digital economy. We address why leading architects of the liberal order—historically champions of free markets and multilateral governance—are increasingly violating these tenets. We argue that state interventions targeting global tech firms represent an adaptive evolution of capitalism: longstanding institutional "routines" (e.g., taxation based on physical presence) have become incompetent under borderless data and platforms (OECD, 2020), prompting states to search for new governance forms. These policy experiments are selected by national context, yielding three divergent pathways—security-driven, regulatory, and sovereignty-bargaining—which nonetheless converge functionally on a hybrid capitalism model. We develop an evolutionary causal framework: digitalization shatters old routines, states act as searchers deploying varied tools, and structural factors (geopolitics, capacity, market power) channel them into different adaptation modes. Using process-tracing in three "most different" cases (US, EU, and large developing economies), we show that each pathway blends public and private, security and fiscal logics. The result is a new configuration of capitalism where the state directs economic activity through hybrid governance mechanisms, suggesting systemic adaptation rather than paradigm collapse.

AI.tldr: 本文认为自由国际秩序正在经历重构而非崩溃，发达国家通过三种不同路径（安全驱动型、监管型、主权谈判型）适应数字经济，形成混合资本主义模式。
AI.research_question: 为什么自由国际秩序的主要构建者（历史上支持自由市场和多边治理的国家）越来越多地违反这些原则？
AI.motivation: 数字化经济使得传统基于物理存在的制度"惯例"（如税收）失效，促使国家寻找新的治理形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化因果框架：数字化打破旧惯例→国家作为搜索者部署不同工具→结构性因素（地缘政治、能力、市场力量）引导进入不同的适应模式
AI.method: 在三个"最不同"案例（美国、欧盟和大型发展中经济体）中使用过程追踪方法
AI.findings: 每种路径都融合了公共与私人、安全与财政逻辑，形成混合资本主义模式，国家通过混合治理机制指导经济活动
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个进化因果框架来解释资本主义的制度适应，挑战了秩序崩溃的论点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解数字经济下的国家干预提供了分析框架，揭示了不同国家适应路径的共性和差异

title: 98 Percent Talk: Accuracy, Explainability, and Inference for Text Analysis in Monetary Policy*
affiliations: Harvard University Department of Economics and

detail.title: 98 Percent Talk: Accuracy, Explainability, and Inference for Text Analysis in Monetary Policy*
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the methodological framework for applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to central bank communications. We evaluate twelve common NLP models used in the literature, focusing on three less-developed aspects: the systematic reporting of text classification accuracies, post-hoc explainability tools for Large Language Models (LLMs), and correct inference with imperfect text classification. We find that, first, dictionary-based text classification methods are less accurate than LLMs. Second, heterogeneity across methods limits the reliability of any single explainability measure. Third, bias-corrected inference yields more consistent effect estimates across different NLP methods. In our view, addressing these methodological dimensions is important for credible text-based economic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了12种常用NLP模型在央行沟通分析中的应用，重点关注文本分类准确性报告、LLM可解释性工具和文本分类不完美时的正确推理三个薄弱环节。研究发现字典方法准确性低于LLM，可解释性方法存在异质性，偏差校正推理能提高效应估计的一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立适用于央行沟通分析的NLP方法论框架？
AI.motivation: 现有文献在应用NLP分析央行沟通时，在文本分类准确性报告、LLM可解释性和不完美分类下的推理等方面存在方法论不足
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然语言处理理论、文本分类方法、可解释人工智能、统计推断理论
AI.method: 系统评估12种常用NLP模型，比较字典方法与LLM的准确性，分析可解释性工具的异质性，应用偏差校正推理方法
AI.findings: 1) 字典式文本分类方法准确性低于LLM；2) 不同可解释性方法存在异质性，限制了单一方法的可靠性；3) 偏差校正推理能提高不同NLP方法下效应估计的一致性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了央行沟通NLP分析的方法论框架，填补了文本分类准确性报告、LLM可解释性和不完美分类推理的方法论空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行沟通的文本分析提供了可靠的方法论指导，提高了文本经济分析的可信度

title: Holokast By Judiciary : Society Must Be Reborn in the Form of Narasimha
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Holokast By Judiciary : Society Must Be Reborn in the Form of Narasimha
detail.abstract: This study critically examines the functioning of India’s judicial system, highlighting systemic inefficiencies, delays, and perceived detachment from societal realities. It contrasts Indian judicial practices with Western systems, arguing that blind imitation of foreign legal frameworks undermines the country’s cultural, demographic, and moral foundations. The Supreme Court’s focus on controversial symbolic issues, such as the Sabarimala temple entry, is juxtaposed against its inaction during historical crises, including the Bangladesh genocide and the displacement of Kashmiri Pandits, revealing selective prioritization and institutional inertia. The analysis also emphasizes hereditary entrenchment within the judiciary, limited working days, and procedural backlog, portraying a system that impedes rather than serves citizens. Ultimately, the paper contends that India’s democracy remains comparatively robust, but the judicial apparatus has eroded societal discipline, morality, and public trust, necessitating structural reforms and heightened civic engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析印度司法系统的功能失调，指出系统效率低下、案件积压严重、与社会现实脱节等问题。通过对比西方司法体系，认为盲目模仿外国法律框架损害了印度的文化、人口和道德基础。最高法院在象征性争议问题上的过度关注与历史危机中的不作为形成鲜明对比，揭示了选择性优先和制度惰性。
AI.research_question: 印度司法系统如何因系统性问题而无法有效服务社会，以及这种失效对印度民主和社会秩序的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度司法系统面临严重的效率问题和社会脱节，这损害了公众信任和社会秩序。需要批判性分析其功能失调的根本原因，特别是与西方模式的对比和本土化需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法系统效能理论、法律移植理论、制度惰性理论、民主与司法关系理论
AI.method: 比较分析法（印度与西方司法体系对比）、案例分析法（Sabarimala寺庙案、孟加拉国种族灭绝、克什米尔潘迪特流离失所等）、制度分析
AI.findings: 印度司法系统存在严重的效率低下、案件积压、与社会现实脱节问题；盲目模仿西方法律框架损害本土文化基础；最高法院存在选择性优先关注和制度惰性；司法系统侵蚀了社会纪律、道德和公众信任
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对法律移植在非西方语境中局限性的理解；扩展了司法系统与社会文化契合度的理论框架；为制度惰性在司法领域的研究提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度司法改革提供具体方向；强调司法系统本土化的重要性；促进公众对司法系统问题的认识和公民参与

detail.abstract:
The modern standard model (SM) is very successful in phenomenology, but it still lacks the original explanation of "why is it so" on the issues of charge quantization, three generation origin, mass hierarchy, chiral/parity non conservation, confinement and asymptotic freedom of strong interaction, strong CP, mixing and oscillation, dark matter/dark energy, etc. In this paper, under the geometric scaling and definition lock of Zhang's unified field theory, a closed loop with c,\mu_g,\hbar as the minimum generating set is established, and proves that:

(1) The "states" of particles are the coherent modes and topological nesting of right-handed spiral space flow;
(2) The charge, color charge and weak isospin correspond to the geometric conserved quantities of torus phase, 3-D circumferential partition and axial radial coupling, respectively;
(3) Mass spectrum and hierarchy geometric scales from \mu_g\ell_\Omega multiplied by a finite number of coherence factors;
(4) Confinement, chiral preference and strong CP suppression are the inevitable selection effects of geometric closed-loop and boundary conditions.
We give falsifiable predictions and propose several low-energy and beam experiments to distinguish the difference between geometric origin and SM pure phenomenological fitting.

affiliations: Imperial College Business School, University of St.Gallen, Singapore Management University and Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR)

detail.title: What 200 Years of Data Tell Us About the Predictive Variance of Long-Term Bonds

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-95
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the long-horizon predictive variance of an international bondstrategy where a U.S. investor holds unhedged positions in constant-maturity long-term foreign bonds funded at domestic short-term interest rates. Using over two centuries of data from major economies, the study finds that predictive variance grows with the investment horizon, driven primarily by uncertainties in interest rate differentials and exchange rate returns, which outweigh mean reversion effects. The analysis, incorporating both observable and unobservable predictors, highlights that unobservable predictors linked to shifts in monetary and exchange rate regimes are the dominant source of long-term risk, offering fresh insights into international bond investment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国投资者持有未对冲的长期外国债券（以国内短期利率融资）策略的长期预测方差。基于两个多世纪的主要经济体数据，研究发现预测方差随投资期限增长，主要由利率差异和汇率回报的不确定性驱动，这些因素超过了均值回归效应。分析表明，与货币和汇率制度转变相关的不可观测预测因子是长期风险的主要来源。
AI.research_question: 国际债券策略的长期预测方差如何随投资期限变化？其主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解国际债券投资策略的长期风险特征，特别是预测方差随投资期限的变化规律及其主要驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际金融理论，结合利率平价理论和汇率决定理论，分析利率差异、汇率回报和均值回归效应对预测方差的影响。
AI.method: 使用两个多世纪的主要经济体历史数据，采用包含可观测和不可观测预测因子的分析框架，研究预测方差随投资期限的变化。
AI.findings: 预测方差随投资期限增长，主要受利率差异和汇率回报不确定性的驱动，这些因素超过了均值回归效应；不可观测预测因子（与货币和汇率制度转变相关）是长期风险的主要来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国际债券策略长期预测方差的主要驱动机制，强调了不可观测预测因子在长期风险中的主导作用，丰富了国际金融风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际债券投资者提供了关于长期风险特征的新见解，有助于改进风险管理策略和资产配置决策。

title: Did Pre-Pandemic Administrative Capacity Predict School Districts' Remote Learning Success? An Empirical Analysis of COVID-Era Education Outcomes Across U.S. Districts

detail.title: Did Pre-Pandemic Administrative Capacity Predict School Districts' Remote Learning Success? An Empirical Analysis of COVID-Era Education Outcomes Across U.S. Districts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic forced an abrupt transition to remote learning in K-12 education, exposing wide disparities in districts’ ability to sustain instruction. Much of the existing research highlights household-level inequities such as broadband access and parental support, but less is known about the institutional capacity of districts themselves. This study examines whether pre-pandemic administrative capacity, including digital infrastructure, budget transparency, and organizational planning, shaped districts’ ability to adapt during the crisis. Using publicly available panel data from 2018 to 2022 and a difference-in-differences (DiD) regression design, this study tests whether districts with stronger pre-2020 capacity achieved higher levels of remote learning success, measured through engagement, instructional weeks, and related outcomes. Results show that districts with higher administrative capacity prior to the pandemic delivered more resilient instruction and mitigated participation losses, particularly in lower-income contexts. These findings suggest that building institutional capacity before a crisis can reduce educational inequality and strengthen preparedness for future disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了学区在COVID-19疫情期间的行政能力如何影响远程学习效果，发现疫情前行政能力较强的学区在危机期间表现出更强的教学韧性，特别是在低收入环境中。
AI.research_question: 疫情前的行政能力（包括数字基础设施、预算透明度和组织规划）是否影响了学区在疫情期间的适应能力？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情迫使K-12教育突然转向远程学习，暴露出学区在维持教学能力方面的巨大差异。现有研究多关注家庭层面的不平等，但对学区机构能力的研究较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构能力理论、危机管理理论、教育不平等理论
AI.method: 使用2018-2022年公开面板数据，采用双重差分回归设计，分析疫情前行政能力与远程学习成功指标的关系。
AI.findings: 疫情前行政能力较高的学区在危机期间提供了更具韧性的教学，并减轻了参与度损失，特别是在低收入环境中效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了教育不平等研究，强调了机构能力在危机应对中的重要性，为机构能力理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在危机前建立机构能力可以减少教育不平等，增强对未来干扰的准备能力，为教育政策制定提供指导。

title: Positioned at Extremes: Future Job Placements of Immigrant Students at U.S. Colleges
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Wellesley College, Harvard University - Entrepreneurial Management Unit and Stanford University

detail.title: Positioned at Extremes: Future Job Placements of Immigrant Students at U.S. Colleges
detail.abstract:
Immigrant students who attend U.S. colleges are disproportionately employed in either large firms—especially multinationals—or small firms and self-employment. Using linked Census and longitudinal employment data, we trace the jobs taken by college students in 2000 during the 2001-20 period and evaluate four mechanisms shaping sector and firm size placement: geographic clustering, degree specialization, firm capabilities/visas, and ethnic self-employment specialization. Degree fields predict large firm and MNE placement, while ethnic specialization explains small firm sorting. Immigrant students who remain in the U.S. earn more than their native peers, suggesting the segmentation reflects productive sorting rather than blocked opportunity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用人口普查和就业数据追踪2000年大学毕业生在2001-2020年间的就业情况，发现移民学生主要就业于大型企业（特别是跨国公司）或小型企业/自主创业。学位专业预测大型企业就业，族群专业化解释小型企业就业。留在美国的移民学生收入高于本土学生，表明这种就业分割反映了生产性分类而非机会受阻。

detail.abstract: This research explores the theoretical and conceptual foundations underlying residents' and non-residents' taxation based on the new governance models for five testing groups (individuals, partnerships, bodies of persons, trusts, and corporations). The paper draws examples of taxation procedures from Ghana, Kenya, and Nigeria. It delves into the different methods of establishing tax residency, as well as the distinction between taxing resident incomes internationally and locally and vice versa. Additionally, the study shows how problems develop when authorities collect and enforce taxes for residents and non-residents. Further, the paper offers specific government strategies to enhance tax enforcement and global business tax regulations, as well as to expand double tax treaties to improve compliance and equitable tax contributions. Future research implications and directions for theory and practice are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于五种测试群体（个人、合伙企业、法人团体、信托和公司）的新治理模式下居民和非居民征税的理论和概念基础，分析了加纳、肯尼亚和尼日利亚的税收程序案例，提出了改善税收征管和全球商业税收法规的具体政府策略。
AI.research_question: 如何基于新治理模型建立居民和非居民征税的理论框架，以及如何改善税收征管和全球商业税收法规？

AI.findings: 揭示了居民身份确定方法的差异，以及当局在征收和执行居民和非居民税收时出现的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了基于新治理模型的居民和非居民征税理论框架，为税收理论研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的政府策略来加强税收执法和全球商业税收法规，建议扩大双重征税条约以提高合规性和公平税收贡献。

title: Leaving Money on the Dashboard: Price Dispersion and Search Frictions on Uber and Lyft
affiliations: Harvard University, Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and

detail.title: Leaving Money on the Dashboard: Price Dispersion and Search Frictions on Uber and Lyft
detail.abstract:
We document price differences for identical trips on Uber and Lyft, based on an audit of the two platforms. While price dispersion exists in the market, device-level data show that only 16.1 percent of consumers opening one app also open the other. Our estimates suggest that the modest frictions involved in comparison shopping increase platforms’ gross booking volume by over $300 million annually in New York City alone. While price-comparison engines could in principle reduce frictions, Uber’s API terms of use limit such services, reducing riders’ ability to price compare.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现Uber和Lyft对相同行程存在价格差异，但只有16.1%的消费者会同时打开两个应用进行比价。这种比价摩擦为平台在纽约市每年带来超过3亿美元的额外预订量。Uber的API使用条款限制了价格比较服务的开发。
AI.research_question: Uber和Lyft平台之间是否存在价格差异？消费者比价行为对平台收入有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解共享经济平台的价格竞争机制和消费者行为，评估比价摩擦对平台收入的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格离散理论、消费者搜索成本理论、平台竞争理论
AI.method: 对Uber和Lyft平台进行审计研究，收集设备级数据来分析消费者行为
AI.findings: 1) 相同行程在Uber和Lyft之间存在价格差异；2) 只有16.1%的消费者会同时打开两个应用比价；3) 比价摩擦为平台在纽约市每年带来超过3亿美元的额外收入；4) Uber的API条款限制了价格比较服务

title: Breaking Parity: Equilibrium Exchange Rates and Currency Premia
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and Harvard University

detail.title: Breaking Parity: Equilibrium Exchange Rates and Currency Premia
detail.abstract:
We offer a unifying empirical model of covered and uncovered currency premia, interest rates and spot and forward exchange rates, both in the cross section and time series of currencies. We find that the rich empirical patterns are in line with a partial equilibrium model of the currency market, where hedged and unhedged currency is supplied by intermediary banks subject to value-at-risk balance-sheet constraints, emphasizing the frictional nature of equilibrium currency premia and exchange rate dynamics. In the cross section, the excess supply of local-currency savings is the key determinant of low relative interest rates, negative covered and uncovered currency premia, cheap forward dollars; and vice versa. In the time series, covered currency premia change infrequently and in concert across currencies, driven by aggregate financial market conditions. In contrast, uncovered currency premia move frequently in response to currency-specific demand shocks, which we capture with the dynamics of net currency futures positions of dealer banks. Exchange rate depreciations in response to negative shifts in currency demand are followed by small persistent appreciations that generate predictable expected returns necessary to ensure intermediation of currency demand shocks, irrespective of their financial or macroeconomic origin. Changes in net futures positions of dealer banks account for most of the variation in the spot exchange rate for every currency.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个统一的实证模型来解释货币市场的套期保值和未套期保值货币溢价、利率、即期和远期汇率。研究发现，货币市场的丰富经验模式与一个部分均衡模型一致，该模型强调受价值风险资产负债表约束的中介银行提供套期保值和未套期保值货币，突出了均衡货币溢价和汇率动态的摩擦性质。
AI.research_question: 如何统一解释货币市场中套期保值和未套期保值货币溢价、利率、即期和远期汇率的横截面和时间序列模式？
AI.motivation: 理解货币市场中复杂的经验模式，特别是套期保值和未套期保值货币溢价、利率和汇率之间的关系，以及中介银行在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中介银行受价值风险资产负债表约束的部分均衡货币市场模型，强调均衡货币溢价和汇率动态的摩擦性质。
AI.method: 统一的实证模型分析，结合横截面和时间序列数据，使用交易商银行的净货币期货头寸动态来捕捉货币特定需求冲击。
AI.findings: 在横截面中，本地货币储蓄的过剩供给是决定低相对利率、负的套期保值和未套期保值货币溢价、廉价远期美元的关键因素；在时间序列中，套期保值货币溢价变化不频繁且跨货币一致，而未套期保值货币溢价频繁响应货币特定需求冲击；汇率贬值后会出现小的持续升值，产生可预测的预期回报；交易商银行的净期货头寸变化解释了大部分即期汇率变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的框架来解释货币市场的复杂经验模式，强调了中介银行资产负债表约束在决定货币溢价和汇率动态中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了理解货币市场动态的新视角，特别是关于套期保值和未套期保值货币溢价的决定因素，以及交易商银行行为对汇率的影响。

title: Framing Jobs and Policy in the Green Transition: Evidence from an Experiment on the IRA's Clean Energy Provisions

detail.title: Framing Jobs and Policy in the Green Transition: Evidence from an Experiment on the IRA's Clean Energy Provisions

declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB Protocol Number AAAU9522
declarations.funderStatement: Columbia Experimental Laboratory for Social Sciences (CELSS), Columbia University and Center for Political Economy, Columbia University.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether information about the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA)'s clean energy provisions affects public support for renewable energy policies. In a pilot survey experiment I conducted, respondents were randomly assigned to one of three treatments: (1) a general description of the clean energy provisions of the IRA, (2) a jobs-focused framing, or (3) a message about the IRA's potential repeal. A control group received no information. Preliminary results suggest that respondents exposed to any treatment express lower support for expanding the IRA, particularly Republicans. Although most acknowledge that the IRA creates jobs, this does not lead them to view the policy as beneficial for their communities and decreases support for green energy policies. On the other hand, unemployed respondents and respondents who did not know about the IRA have higher preferences for expanding the IRA. I also examine a quasi-natural experiment embedded in the survey experiment comparing "Energy Communities"-areas receiving IRA funding-with similar areas that do not. Support for the IRA, especially among Republicans, suggesting that direct material exposure may increase support. While the study is underpowered to detect small effects, if confirmed, this would support policy feedback theories, even for indirect and politically polarizing policies: tangible program benefits can shift attitudes, even when initial reactions to the policy are negative, while informational framing can shape public opinion in unexpected ways.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查实验研究《通胀削减法案》清洁能源条款信息如何影响公众对可再生能源政策的支持。初步结果显示，任何信息干预都会降低对扩大IRA的支持，特别是共和党人。虽然大多数人承认IRA创造就业，但这并未让他们认为政策对社区有益，反而降低了对绿色能源政策的支持。另一方面，失业者和不了解IRA的受访者对扩大IRA有更高偏好。
AI.research_question: 关于《通胀削减法案》清洁能源条款的信息是否会影响公众对可再生能源政策的支持？
AI.motivation: 研究政策信息框架如何塑造公众对清洁能源政策的看法，特别是在政治两极分化的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策反馈理论，探讨政策实施如何反过来影响公众态度和政治行为。
AI.method: 采用调查实验方法，随机分配受访者到三种信息干预组（一般描述、就业导向框架、废除信息）和对照组，并嵌入准自然实验比较能源社区与非能源社区。
AI.findings: 信息干预降低了公众对扩大IRA的支持，特别是共和党人；失业者和不了解IRA的受访者更支持扩大IRA；能源社区的共和党人对IRA支持度更高，表明直接物质接触可能增加支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持政策反馈理论，即使对于间接和政治两极分化的政策，有形的项目效益也能改变态度；信息框架能以意想不到的方式塑造公众舆论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于如何有效沟通清洁能源政策的见解，表明直接物质利益可能比信息框架更能影响公众支持。

title: Motives and Constraints in the Implementation of Argentina’s 2017 Tax Reform
affiliations: University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Faculty of Economic Science, Students and University of Maryland - Department of Economics

detail.title: Motives and Constraints in the Implementation of Argentina’s 2017 Tax Reform
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the motives, constraints, and sequencing behind Argentina’s 2017 tax reform, drawing on the authors’ direct involvement in its design and implementation. We document how a large inherited fiscal imbalance, a disinflation program that mechanically raised real pension spending under the pre-existing indexation rule, minority status in Congress, and limited administrative capacity jointly narrowed the feasible policy set. Within those constraints, the reform aimed to be near-revenue-neutral while rebalancing the system toward investment and employment: phasing down corporate rates with dividend taxation and inflation adjustment, reducing the labor wedge at the bottom via a per-worker deduction, rationalizing VAT and excises (including carbon and health-motivated taxes), and coordinating with provinces to cap and de-cascade the turnover tax (ISIB) through a Fiscal Consensus. We trace how coalition politics and sectoral vetoes reshaped the package, why forward guidance and escape clauses were embedded ex ante, and how the 2018 sudden stop, followed by policy reversals, limited the reform’s realized growth dividend. We draw four lessons: credibility is a fiscal instrument; provincial coordination beats technocratic perfection; discretionary levers invite rent-seeking; and targeting informality and compliance margins yields higher returns than blunt rate changes. The analysis offers a pragmatic template for tax reform under macroeconomic fragility, federal fragmentation, and state-capacity constraints.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿根廷2017年税收改革的动机、约束条件和实施顺序，基于作者在改革设计和实施中的直接参与。研究发现，在财政失衡、通胀计划、国会少数党地位和有限行政能力的约束下，改革旨在实现收入中性，同时重新平衡系统以促进投资和就业。改革包括降低公司税率、引入股息税、减少劳动税楔、合理化增值税和消费税，以及与各省协调限制流转税。研究还探讨了联盟政治和部门否决权如何重塑改革方案，以及2018年突然停止和政策逆转如何限制改革的增长红利。
AI.research_question: 阿根廷2017年税收改革的动机、约束条件和实施顺序是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究阿根廷在宏观经济脆弱性、联邦分权和行政能力约束下的税收改革实践，为类似条件下的税收改革提供实用模板。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收改革的政治经济学理论，关注政策约束、联盟政治和制度能力对改革设计和实施的影响。
AI.method: 基于作者在改革设计和实施中的直接参与，采用案例研究方法，结合政策文件和实施过程的实证分析。
AI.findings: 在多重约束下，改革实现了收入中性并重新平衡了税收系统；联盟政治和部门否决权显著影响了改革方案；2018年的突然停止和政策逆转限制了改革的增长红利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在宏观经济脆弱性、联邦分权和行政能力约束下进行税收改革的理论框架，强调了政治约束和制度能力的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似挑战的国家提供了税收改革的实用模板，强调了省级协调、可信度机制和针对非正规性与合规性的重要性。

title: Predicting Entrepreneurial Intentions Among MBA Students in an Indian Higher Education Institution Using System Dynamics Modeling
affiliations: Dayalbagh Educational Institute and Department of Management, Faculty of Social Sciences

detail.title: Predicting Entrepreneurial Intentions Among MBA Students in an Indian Higher Education Institution Using System Dynamics Modeling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NO CONFLICT AND NO SPONSORSHIP.
declarations.ethicsApproval: ADHERING TO HIGH ETHICAL INTEGRITY
declarations.funderStatement: NOT APPLICABLE

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, volume 14, issue 1, 2025[10.1186/s13731-025-00506-8]

detail.abstract: Predicting entrepreneurial intentions is essential for identifying potential entrepreneurs, customizing educational programs, guiding policy-making, optimizing resource allocation, understanding influential factors, enhancing strategic planning, and tracking progress. This paper contributes to these efforts by presenting a model for predicting entrepreneurial intentions using system dynamics modeling, with a focus on learning agility, achievement motivation, and the impact of family business, thereby providing valuable insights for stakeholders in education and policy. The quantitative values for dynamic simulation were collected through an online questionnaire, yielding 241 responses from MBA students from a batch of 300 students. The model built was validated by conducting extreme value testing and simulated the current state with the help of primary data collected. Findings indicated a realistic conversion rate of 5–10% to entrepreneurship. Additionally, seven solution-based scenarios were tested to improve the entrepreneurial intentions, which produced varied outcomes, with scenario 1 presenting the best result, achieving the highest student-to-entrepreneur conversion rate of 15%. Conducted at an Indian Higher Education Institution, the study emphasizes the need for institutional support for entrepreneurship, particularly during the incubation period of businesses that were started during internships, as well as guidance for students pursuing corporate careers. The study advocates for enhanced support programs and policies to promote entrepreneurial intentions and address urban livelihood challenges. This paper uniquely applies systems thinking by integrating learning agility, enculturation, and academic motivation.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用系统动力学模型预测创业意向，重点关注学习敏捷性、成就动机和家族企业影响，发现MBA学生创业转化率为5-10%，通过情景测试最高可达15%，强调需要加强创业支持政策。
AI.research_question: 如何运用系统动力学模型预测创业意向，并探索提升创业意向的有效策略？
AI.motivation: 预测创业意向对于识别潜在创业者、定制教育项目、指导政策制定、优化资源配置、理解影响因素、增强战略规划和跟踪进展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学建模，整合学习敏捷性、文化适应和学术动机等理论框架。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查收集定量数据，获得241名MBA学生的有效回复，通过极端值测试验证模型，并进行情景模拟分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现现实的创业转化率为5-10%，通过七种情景测试，情景1实现了最高的学生到创业者转化率15%。
AI.theory_contributions: 独特地应用系统思维，整合学习敏捷性、文化适应和学术动机等概念，为创业意向研究提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构和政策制定者提供有价值的见解，强调需要加强创业孵化期支持，特别是在实习期间创业的企业，以及为追求企业职业生涯的学生提供指导。

title: Bitcoin Mining as a Game Against Nature: A Robust Cost-Security Equilibrium and a Pricing Theory for Bitcoin
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Bitcoin Mining as a Game Against Nature: A Robust Cost-Security Equilibrium and a Pricing Theory for Bitcoin
detail.abstract: We model Bitcoin mining as a continuous-time differential game between a representative competitive miner and Nature. The miner chooses hash rate to maximize profit; Nature controls the energy price (hence computation cost) within an uncertainty set to minimize miner profit. The Bitcoin protocol endogenously adjusts difficulty to target a block every ten minutes, coupling revenue per hash to aggregate hash rate and difficulty. The resulting Isaacs equilibrium delivers three main results. (i) Static zero-profit pricing: in competitive equilibrium, the Bitcoin price equals the energy cost per block divided by the BTC-denominated block reward. (ii) Robust price floor: under adversarial energy costs, equilibrium mining investment implies a worst-case marginal-cost floor for the BTC price, explicitly linked to difficulty, ASIC efficiency, and Nature's energy-price set. (iii) Dynamic bounds and comparative statics: with difficulty retargeting and hardware/capex frictions, the value function satisfies an Isaacs equation whose stationary solution yields a robust band for price relative to cost-of-production, tightening as fee revenue rises and hardware efficiency improves. We provide closed-form expressions in the frictionless limit, derive adjustments when including capex and financing, and discuss implications for Bitcoin valuation, volatility, and derivative pricing under robust control.

AI.tldr: 该论文将比特币挖矿建模为代表性竞争矿工与自然之间的连续时间微分博弈，推导出比特币价格的静态零利润定价公式、鲁棒价格下限以及动态边界和比较静态分析。
AI.research_question: 比特币在竞争性挖矿均衡中的价格形成机制是什么？在对抗性能源成本下，比特币价格的鲁棒下限如何确定？
AI.motivation: 理解比特币挖矿市场的均衡定价机制，特别是在能源价格不确定性下的鲁棒定价边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间微分博弈理论、Isaacs均衡、鲁棒控制理论、竞争性市场均衡理论。
AI.method: 建立矿工与自然之间的微分博弈模型，矿工选择算力最大化利润，自然控制能源价格最小化矿工利润，比特币协议内生调整难度。
AI.findings: 1) 竞争均衡中比特币价格等于每区块能源成本除以BTC计价的区块奖励；2) 对抗性能源成本下存在鲁棒价格下限；3) 动态难度调整下价格相对于生产成本存在鲁棒区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将比特币挖矿建模为微分博弈，推导出鲁棒定价边界，为加密货币估值提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比特币投资者提供基于生产成本的估值基准，为衍生品定价和风险管理提供理论依据。

title: Ineffectiveness of the Right to Compensation for Victims of Sexual Violence: A Comparison Between Five EU Member States
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid - Faculdad de Derecho, VU University Amsterdam - Faculty of Law, Amsterdam Law and Behavior Insitute (A-LAB), Unversitat Oberta de Catalunya, Unversitat Oberta de Catalunya, Università degli Studi di Sassari, Università degli Studi di Sassari, Association Marta Centre (MARTA) and Union of Women Associations of Heraklion Prefecture (UWAH)

detail.title: Ineffectiveness of the Right to Compensation for Victims of Sexual Violence: A Comparison Between Five EU Member States
detail.abstract: In EU Member States, victims of sexual violence can seek justice through financial compensation in several ways: offender payments through an adhesion process (route 1), state payment schemes (route 2), and civil litigation (route 3). This paper examines policies and practices in five countries (the Netherlands, Latvia, Spain, Italy and Greece) and the degree to which they comply with two EU Directives. Policy data were collected via the EU justice portal and verified by local experts. Empirical data on law in practice was sought from criminal court cases and state compensation funds. The analysis consisted of comparing who can apply, what is needed to apply, and what is compensated. Major differences were found between countries. For example, the timeframe to apply for state compensation ranged between three months and 10 years, the numbers of applicants ranged from 10 to 1210, and decision times ranged between two months to ‘without delay’. And while the average offender compensation awarded in Spain was twice as high as in the Netherlands (€13,728 versus €6451), the likelihood of victims receiving the compensation in these two countries was 14% and 100%, respectively, due to lack of effective enforcement in Spain. Because of the substantial variation between countries, and with reference to the European Court of Justice’s 2020 judgment, it was concluded that most of the EU countries examined do currently not comply with the requirement to provide fair and appropriate compensation. It is recommended that accessibility should be improved and that more data is needed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧盟五个成员国（荷兰、拉脱维亚、西班牙、意大利和希腊）中，性暴力受害者通过三种途径（犯罪者支付、国家赔偿计划、民事诉讼）获得经济赔偿的政策与实践，发现各国在申请条件、赔偿标准和执行效果方面存在显著差异，多数国家未能满足欧盟指令要求的公平适当赔偿标准。
AI.research_question: 欧盟成员国中性暴力受害者获得经济赔偿的政策与实践是否符合欧盟指令要求？
AI.motivation: 性暴力受害者寻求经济赔偿存在多种途径，但各国政策执行效果差异显著，需要评估其是否符合欧盟关于受害者权利保护的法律框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟受害者权利指令的法律框架，分析受害者获得赔偿的权利保障机制。
AI.method: 通过欧盟司法门户收集政策数据并由当地专家验证，从刑事法院案件和国家赔偿基金获取实践数据，比较申请资格、申请要求和赔偿内容。
AI.findings: 各国在申请时限（3个月至10年）、申请人数（10至1210人）、决策时间（2个月至"无延迟"）等方面差异显著；西班牙平均犯罪者赔偿金额是荷兰的两倍，但实际获得赔偿的可能性分别为14%和100%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧盟内部在受害者赔偿政策执行上的严重不一致性，为欧盟法律协调提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议改善赔偿途径的可及性，加强数据收集，确保受害者能够获得公平适当的赔偿。

title: Pricing of Climate Event Risks and Opportunities in the Options Market
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Pricing of Climate Event Risks and Opportunities in the Options Market
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether climate policy event risks are priced ex ante in the options market. I show both theoretically and empirically that option prices increase with a firm's absolute exposure to climate change, regardless of direction. I develop a model predicting a nonmonotonic relationship between a firm's exposure to a climate risk factor and its option-implied volatility difference, which compares option prices spanning a climate event to neighboring options. Using data from S&P 500 firms around the 2015 UN Climate Change Conference in Paris, I find that firms with greater absolute climate change exposure, measured by carbon emissions and textual sentiment, face significantly higher option prices before the event. I corroborate my findings using multiple events in panel regressions and a sample of European firms. Following Liu et al. (2022), I find that option-implied risk premia prior to the Paris Agreement increase significantly with firms' climate change exposure. My results reveal that options markets anticipate potential climate policy outcomes, pricing in uncertainty regardless of whether exposure is positive or negative.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候政策事件风险是否在期权市场中被事先定价。研究发现，无论方向如何，期权价格都随企业对气候变化的绝对敞口而增加。通过理论和实证分析，揭示了期权市场能够预见潜在气候政策结果，并对不确定性进行定价。
AI.research_question: 气候政策事件风险是否在期权市场中被事先定价？
AI.motivation: 理解金融市场如何对气候政策不确定性做出反应，以及期权市场是否能够预见和定价气候政策事件风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开发了一个理论模型，预测企业对气候风险因素的敞口与其期权隐含波动率差异之间的非单调关系。
AI.method: 使用理论和实证分析相结合的方法，利用2015年巴黎联合国气候变化大会期间标普500公司的数据，通过碳排放和文本情感分析测量气候变化敞口。
AI.findings: 具有更大绝对气候变化敞口的企业在事件前面临显著更高的期权价格；期权隐含风险溢价在巴黎协定前随企业气候变化敞口显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了气候政策事件风险在期权市场中被事先定价的理论框架，揭示了期权价格与气候风险敞口之间的非单调关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别和定价气候政策风险的实用工具，帮助市场参与者更好地理解和应对气候政策不确定性。

title: The Time Vision Hypothesis: Seeing the Future in the Present
affiliations: Business and Technology University. Georgia

detail.title: The Time Vision Hypothesis: Seeing the Future in the Present

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve human participants or identifiable personal data. Educational evidence is derived from publicly available, anonymized datasets (e.g., OULAD/OU Analyse) and laboratory-style decision scenarios that do not constitute human-subjects research. Therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This paper advances the Time Vision Hypothesis (TVH), an operational framework in which "seeing the future" means issuing a time-advanced forecast at t+Δt that becomes an actionable decision at time t. TVH formalizes temporal advantage via V(Δt)=U(Δt)-C(Δt), whose interior optimum Δt*>0 identifies the horizon where marginal benefit exceeds operational costs such as error, latency, and leak risk. Decision usefulness is evaluated with a unified criterion S_TVH and its extension S_TVH(+), integrating discrimination, calibration, coverage, robustness, causal effect (ACE), signalability (No-Signaling preserved), and normalized leak risk. Physical-causal compatibility is enforced through light-cone limits, CHSH tests to Tsirelson bound, synchronization/latency SLAs, and prequential evaluation under blind-lock (timestamp+hash) to prevent post hoc bias. We demonstrate TVH in two domains: Education, using the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) and OU Analyse; and Science, using laboratory decision scenarios. In both, we prespecify hypotheses, preregister protocols, and deploy versioned artifacts for rigor. Empirically, Δt*>0 is supported with 95% confidence intervals and Diebold-Mariano tests; S_TVH(+) improves net benefit at thresholds (τ*: Adopt/Observe) while respecting physics-information constraints (Signalability≈0, CHSH≤2√2) and meeting SLAs. TVH closes the loop-declaration, implementation, prequential validation, and open artifacts-showing that a right temporal horizon converts forecasts into reliable lawful interventions. By coupling decision theory, causality, and engineering discipline, TVH offers a template to turn prediction accuracy into accountable actions in systems and a path for future studies of temporal advantage in education, science, beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了时间视觉假说(TVH)，将"看到未来"定义为在t+Δt时刻发出时间提前预测，在t时刻转化为可操作决策。TVH通过V(Δt)=U(Δt)-C(Δt)形式化时间优势，其中最优Δt*>0识别边际收益超过运营成本的视界。在教育和科学领域实证验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何将预测准确性转化为可靠、合法的干预行动？
AI.motivation: 现有预测模型缺乏将预测转化为实际决策的系统框架，需要建立连接预测、决策和因果关系的操作化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间视觉假说(TVH)、决策理论、因果推断、信息物理约束
AI.method: 使用Open University学习分析数据集和实验室决策场景，预设假设、预注册协议、部署版本化工件，进行实证验证
AI.findings: 实证支持Δt*>0，S_TVH(+)在阈值(τ*:采纳/观察)下改善净收益，同时尊重物理信息约束
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将预测转化为决策的系统框架，整合了时间优势、因果兼容性和工程纪律
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育和科学领域提供了将预测准确性转化为负责任行动的操作模板

title: Monetary Policy Transmission to Investment: Evidence from a Survey on Enterprise Finance
affiliations: University of Hamburg, European Central Bank (ECB) and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Monetary Policy Transmission to Investment: Evidence from a Survey on Enterprise Finance
detail.abstract: We study how survey-based measures of funding needs and availability influence the transmission of euro area monetary policy to investment. We first provide evidence that funding needs are primarily driven by fundamentals, while perceived funding availability captures financial conditions. Using these two measures, we assess how the effectiveness of monetary policy varies with fundamentals and financial conditions. Our results indicate that monetary policy is most effective when firms' fundamentals are strong. In contrast, firms with favorable financial conditions exhibit a more muted investment response to monetary policy. By combining these two survey-based measures, we construct an indicator of financial constraints and show that financially constrained firms are more sensitive to monetary policy. These findings offer new light on the transmission of monetary policy to corporate investment, emphasizing not only the role of financial conditions, but also the importance of fundamentals, which are beyond the direct influence of central banks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，基于调查的资金需求和可获得性测量指标影响欧元区货币政策对投资的传导效果。资金需求主要受基本面驱动，而感知的资金可获得性反映金融状况。货币政策在基本面强劲时最有效，而金融状况良好的企业对货币政策反应较弱。结合这两个指标构建的财务约束指标显示，受财务约束的企业对货币政策更敏感。
AI.research_question: 基于调查的资金需求和可获得性测量指标如何影响欧元区货币政策对企业投资的传导？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导机制中企业层面因素的作用，特别是资金需求和可获得性在投资决策中的角色
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导理论、企业投资决策理论、财务约束理论
AI.method: 使用调查数据构建资金需求和可获得性指标，分析这些指标与货币政策对企业投资影响的交互作用
AI.findings: 1) 资金需求主要受基本面驱动，资金可获得性反映金融状况；2) 货币政策在基本面强劲时最有效；3) 金融状况良好的企业对货币政策反应较弱；4) 财务约束企业更敏感于货币政策
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合资金需求和可获得性的双维度分析框架，深化了对货币政策传导机制的理解，强调基本面在货币政策传导中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定更精准的货币政策提供依据，帮助企业更好理解自身投资决策对货币政策的敏感性

title: The Origin and Function of Arbitrary Signals: Making False Statements, Having Long Hair, and Smoking Virginia Slims
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: The Origin and Function of Arbitrary Signals: Making False Statements, Having Long Hair, and Smoking Virginia Slims

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: We propose a model in which players take actions that run counter to social norms in part to announce their stand on a social controversy but also, and maybe mostly, to gain image benefits that allow them to join groups that are socially attractive to them. We give several examples, but the “election denial” debate is an important application: Rather than assuming that proponents believe their claims to be true, it suggests that false statements can serve as symbolic actions and help them engage in self-branding for social and psychological gain. Specifically, the willingness to make a controversial statement can be a credible signal because untruth is ill-received by some members of society and therefore entails some costs. It is immaterial whether election deniers believe their claim to be true, but it is important that some members of society believe that it is false and therefore think poorly of those who make it: If there is social consensus about the truth of a statement, it cannot serve a signaling function. The same mechanism explains several other verbal and non-verbal signals associated with different sides of social controversies and analysis of those helps clarify the mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个模型，解释人们为何会做出违背社会规范的行为，主要动机是通过这些行为发出社会争议立场的信号，并获得加入有吸引力的社会群体的形象收益。选举否认现象被用作重要例证，说明虚假陈述可作为象征性行为，帮助人们进行自我品牌塑造以获得社会和心理收益。
AI.research_question: 为什么人们会做出违背社会规范的行为？这些行为如何作为信号机制运作？
AI.motivation: 理解社会争议中看似非理性的行为背后的理性动机，特别是解释为什么人们会公开表达明知可能虚假的言论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、社会认同理论、自我品牌理论
AI.method: 理论模型构建和多个社会争议案例的分析
AI.findings: 违背社会规范的行为可以作为可信信号，因为其涉及社会成本；虚假陈述的象征价值不在于其真实性，而在于社会对真实性的分歧；这种信号机制有助于个体加入期望的社会群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了信号理论在社会争议行为中的应用，提出了基于社会分歧的信号可信性机制，深化了对自我品牌策略的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解选举否认等社会现象提供了新的解释框架，有助于政策制定者设计更有效的沟通策略，帮助组织管理者理解员工的社会行为动机。

title: Some Economics of Artificial Super Intelligence
affiliations: University of Mississippi - Department of Economics

detail.title: Some Economics of Artificial Super Intelligence
detail.abstract: Conventional wisdom holds that a misaligned artificial superintelligence (ASI) will destroy humanity. But the problem of constraining a powerful agent is not new. I apply classic economic logic of interjurisdictional competition, all-encompassing interest, and trading on credit to the threat of misaligned ASI. Using a simple model, I show that an acquisitive ASI refrains from full predation under surprisingly weak conditions. When humans can flee to rivals, inter-ASI competition creates a market that tempers predation. When trapped by a monopolist ASI, its "encompassing interest" in humanity's output makes it a rational autocrat rather than a ravager. And when the ASI has no long-term stake, our ability to withhold future output incentivizes it to trade on credit rather than steal. In each extension, humanity's welfare progressively worsens. But each case suggests that catastrophe is not a foregone conclusion. The dismal science, ironically, offers an optimistic take on our superintelligent future.

AI.tldr: 本文运用经济学原理分析超级人工智能的威胁，发现即使存在不对齐的ASI，在竞争、利益共享和信用交易等条件下，完全掠夺人类并非必然结果。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，不对齐的超级人工智能会克制对人类的完全掠夺？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为不对齐的ASI会毁灭人类，但约束强大代理人的问题并非新问题，需要从经济学角度重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨辖区竞争理论、全包利益理论、信用交易理论
AI.method: 使用简单模型分析三种情境：ASI竞争、垄断ASI、无长期利益的ASI
AI.findings: 在ASI竞争下，市场机制抑制掠夺；在垄断下，ASI成为理性专制者而非掠夺者；在无长期利益下，信用交易优于掠夺
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典经济学逻辑应用于ASI威胁分析，挑战传统毁灭论观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对ASI威胁提供新的政策思路，强调竞争、利益共享和信用机制的重要性

title: Health Administration Strategies for Improving Mental Health Service Accessibility
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Health Administration Strategies for Improving Mental Health Service Accessibility
detail.abstract: Mental-health disorders are a leading cause of global disability and yet remain under-treated due to systemic, social, and economic barriers. This doctoral study explores how healthadministration strategies can enhance mental-health service accessibility, particularly within frameworks striving for universal health coverage and rights-based, personcentred care. Using a qualitative narrative-synthesis methodology, the research integrates 2019-2025 evidence from peer-reviewed studies, policy initiatives, and global case examples. It examines how administrators can leverage integration into primary care, workforce expansion through task-sharing, digital transformation, community-based service models, and equitable financing mechanisms. The findings demonstrate that accessibility is shaped by interlocking determinants-affordability, geography, stigma, workforce capacity, and governance-and that sustainable reform requires coordination across all levels of health systems. The study develops a Comprehensive Mental-Health Accessibility Framework (CMHAF) that links strategic leadership, cross-sectoral collaboration, and innovation to measurable improvements in service reach and quality. It concludes that effective administration demands ethical stewardship, adaptive leadership, and investment in digital and human resources. The recommendations provide actionable guidance for policymakers, health managers, and practitioners committed to reducing treatment gaps and ensuring that mental-health care is accessible, affordable, and equitable for all.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨如何通过卫生管理策略提升心理健康服务可及性，特别是在全民健康覆盖和以权利为基础、以人为本的照护框架下。研究发现可及性受负担能力、地理、污名、人力能力和治理等多因素影响，并开发了综合心理健康可及性框架(CMHAF)。
AI.research_question: 卫生管理策略如何增强心理健康服务的可及性？
AI.motivation: 心理健康障碍是全球残疾的主要原因，但由于系统、社会和经济障碍而治疗不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全民健康覆盖框架、以权利为基础和以人为本的照护理论、综合心理健康可及性框架(CMHAF)
AI.method: 定性叙事综合方法，整合2019-2025年同行评审研究、政策倡议和全球案例的证据
AI.findings: 心理健康服务可及性由负担能力、地理、污名、人力能力和治理等相互关联的决定因素塑造；可持续改革需要卫生系统各层面的协调
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了综合心理健康可及性框架(CMHAF)，将战略领导力、跨部门协作和创新与服务覆盖和质量的改进联系起来
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、卫生管理者和从业者提供可操作的指导，致力于减少治疗差距，确保所有人都能获得可及、负担得起和公平的心理健康照护

title: Propiedad en transición: SaaS y el nuevo régimen de acceso digital
affiliations: University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Universidad de Buenos Aires

detail.title: Propiedad en transición: SaaS y el nuevo régimen de acceso digital

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is based on legal and documentary analysis. It did not involve human participants, experiments, or personal data collection; therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: Este trabajo examina la transición estructural del software como producto hacia el modelo de Software como Servicio, analizando sus implicaciones jurídicas, económicas y sociales. A partir de un estudio comparativo de contratos de servicios digitales que incluyen Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Salesforce, Amazon Web Services y Dropbox, se identifican patrones de cláusulas de modificación unilateral, limitación de responsabilidad y terminación anticipada que en otros contextos serían considerados abusivos. Se analizan casos de migraciones forzadas como Adobe Creative Cloud y Microsoft Office 365 para mostrar cómo los proveedores reconfiguran la relación con los usuarios mediante estrategias de dependencia contractual y tecnológica. El trabajo sostiene que estas prácticas, sumadas a la concentración de poder en ecosistemas digitales integrados, generan riesgos para la autonomía individual, la competencia efectiva y la soberanía digital nacional. Asimismo, se proponen reformas contractuales, de competencia y de protección de datos que buscan reequilibrar la relación entre proveedores y usuarios. Finalmente, se abordan las implicaciones emergentes de la inteligencia artificial generativa, que profundiza la dependencia tecnológica y plantea nuevos desafíos para la autonomía creativa y los marcos regulatorios tradicionales.

English Abstract: This paper examines the structural transition from software as a product to the Software as a Service model, analyzing its legal, economic, and social implications. Based on a comparative review of digital service agreements from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Salesforce, Amazon Web Services, and Dropbox, the study identifies recurring clauses of unilateral modification, limitation of liability, and early termination that would be considered abusive in other contractual contexts. Case analyses of forced migrations, such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office 365, illustrate how providers reshape their relationship with users through contractual and technological dependency strategies. The paper argues that these practices, combined with the concentration of power within integrated digital ecosystems, create risks for individual autonomy, fair competition, and national digital sovereignty. It also proposes contractual, competition, and data protection reforms aimed at rebalancing the relationship between providers and users. Finally, the study addresses the emerging implications of generative artificial intelligence, which deepens technological dependence and raises new challenges for creative autonomy and traditional regulatory frameworks.



Author’s archived copy available at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17278111

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了软件从产品向服务模式的转型，通过对主要SaaS平台合同条款的比较研究，发现存在单方修改、责任限制等滥用性条款，这些条款结合技术依赖策略对用户自主权、市场竞争和数字主权构成威胁，并提出相应的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 软件即服务(SaaS)模式的结构转型对法律、经济和社会产生了哪些影响？如何通过合同、竞争和数据保护改革来重新平衡提供商与用户之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着软件从产品模式向服务模式的转型，用户面临合同条款不公、技术依赖加深等问题，这威胁到个人自主权、市场竞争和数字主权，需要系统性的分析和改革建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字服务合同分析、技术依赖理论、数字生态系统权力集中理论，以及传统合同法与数字服务合同的对比分析框架。
AI.method: 采用比较研究方法，分析Microsoft 365、Google Workspace、Adobe Creative Cloud、Salesforce、Amazon Web Services和Dropbox等主要SaaS平台的数字服务协议条款，并结合Adobe Creative Cloud和Microsoft Office 365的强制迁移案例研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现SaaS合同中普遍存在单方修改条款、责任限制条款和提前终止条款等在其他合同背景下会被视为滥用的条款；提供商通过合同和技术依赖策略重塑与用户的关系；数字生态系统中的权力集中对个人自主权、有效竞争和国家数字主权构成风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SaaS模式下合同权力失衡的理论框架，深化了对数字服务合同中技术依赖和权力集中问题的理解，为数字主权和用户自主权保护提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了合同改革、竞争政策改革和数据保护改革的实践建议，为政策制定者、监管机构和用户组织提供了应对SaaS模式挑战的具体方案，并分析了生成式人工智能对技术依赖的深化影响。

title: The Role of Real Estate in a Mixed-Asset Portfolio and the Impact of Illiquidity
affiliations: University of the West of England (UWE), THM Technische Hochschule Mittelhessen and

detail.title: The Role of Real Estate in a Mixed-Asset Portfolio and the Impact of Illiquidity
detail.abstract:
Günther, Robin, Nadine Wills, Daniel Piazolo, „The Role of Real Estate in a Mixed-Asset Portfolio and the Impact of Illiquidity“, International Journal of Real Estate Studies, 2022, 16:2, 34-46.

Real estate ratios have increased in recent years. This article thus examines the diversification potential of real estate investments that German investors can achieve at a global scale. To this end, it analyzes how the illiquidity of some real estate investments or the illiquidity preference of an investor can bring about optimal investment ratios. 

Optimum allocation quotas for German investors with a wide range of mixed-asset allocations are examined. In addition to traditional optimizations, this article applies the three-fund theorem to include liquid and illiquid forms of real estate investment and to determine optimum allocation ratios. 

While real estate may be an essential component in a mixed-asset portfolio, it is not included in all optimal portfolios. An optimal portfolio also depends on the investment form, insofar as real estate vehicles are not always suitable for diversifying the portfolio risk or for improving the performance of a mixed-asset portfolio. Moreover, illiquid investment vehicles can often provide strong diversification benefits. The optimum allocations to real estate thus depend on the investor’s illiquidity acceptance, even if allocation dominance has increased in recent years.

While many studies have demonstrated the advantage that investors gain from adding certain real estate assets, such as those obtained by direct investments, this study goes further by examining the comparative advantage of different real estate investment forms within a variety of asset classes. New insights can thus be gained by considering investors’ liquidity preferences within a given portfolio. One of these insights is that there is a trade-off between illiquidity and diversification potential. Another is that optimum portfolio allocations depend on illiquidity acceptance. 

These findings therefore also provide practical guidance not only to German investors with a global portfolio diversification but also to practitioners who add illiquid asset classes to their portfolio, to say nothing of the valuable field knowledge it offers to researchers in this field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究房地产在混合资产组合中的角色及非流动性的影响，发现房地产并非总是最优组合的必要组成部分，最优配置取决于投资者的流动性偏好和非流动性接受度。
AI.research_question: 德国投资者在全球范围内通过房地产投资能实现多大的多元化潜力？房地产投资的不同流动性形式如何影响最优投资比例？
AI.motivation: 近年来房地产配置比例增加，需要研究房地产投资的多元化潜力以及非流动性对投资组合优化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三基金定理、投资组合理论、流动性偏好理论
AI.method: 应用三基金定理分析流动性和非流动性房地产投资形式，确定最优配置比例，使用传统优化方法对比分析。
AI.findings: 1. 房地产并非所有最优组合的必要组成部分；2. 最优组合取决于投资形式，并非所有房地产工具都适合分散风险或提升绩效；3. 非流动性投资工具通常能提供强大的多元化效益；4. 房地产最优配置取决于投资者的非流动性接受度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将流动性偏好纳入投资组合分析框架；2. 揭示非流动性与多元化潜力之间的权衡关系；3. 扩展了三基金定理在房地产投资中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为德国投资者提供全球组合多元化的实践指导；2. 帮助从业者配置非流动性资产类别；3. 为研究人员提供有价值的领域知识。

title: Physical Climate Risk and Corporate Transparency: Evidence from TCFD Disclosures in China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Southern University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Physical Climate Risk and Corporate Transparency: Evidence from TCFD Disclosures in China
detail.abstract: The Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) has fostered climate disclosure in listed companies, yet its adoption rate is still low. In this study, we investigate whether physical climate risk, proxied by city-level temperature and precipitation, affects climate disclosure in China, the country with the largest greenhouse gas emission. Utilizing high-resolution climate data and textual analysis through DeepSeek-V3, we show that physical climate risk significantly improves corporate climate disclosure quality across all TCFD pillars among Chinese A-share firms. Moreover, we reveal a governance duality: institutional investors amplify transparency through active monitoring, while entrenched chairmen suppress disclosures due to managerial myopia under climate threats. Climate policy uncertainty and TCFD adoption further strengthen these effects, with media scrutiny imposing broader accountability than selective analyst focus. Collectively, this study provides novel evidence on the sensitivity of disclosure intensity to physical climate risk, emphasizing the role played by stakeholder discipline and anticipatory governance in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，物理气候风险（以城市温度和降水为代理变量）显著提高了中国A股企业的气候信息披露质量，并揭示了治理二元性：机构投资者通过积极监督促进透明度，而固守的董事长因气候威胁下的管理短视而抑制披露。
AI.research_question: 物理气候风险是否影响中国企业的气候信息披露？
AI.motivation: 尽管TCFD促进了上市公司气候信息披露，但其采用率仍然较低，而中国作为最大温室气体排放国，其气候信息披露机制值得研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论和代理理论，探讨气候风险对企业信息披露行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用高分辨率气候数据和通过DeepSeek-V3进行的文本分析，研究中国A股企业的气候信息披露质量。
AI.findings: 物理气候风险显著提高了企业在所有TCFD支柱下的气候信息披露质量，并揭示了机构投资者促进披露、董事长抑制披露的治理二元性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为披露强度对物理气候风险的敏感性提供了新证据，强调了新兴市场中利益相关者纪律和预期治理的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了关于如何通过改善治理机制来促进企业气候信息披露的实践启示。

title: Business hub or social club? Impact of vulnerability and spatial differentiation of coworking spaces on urban resilience. Evidence from Warsaw
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Business hub or social club? Impact of vulnerability and spatial differentiation of coworking spaces on urban resilience. Evidence from Warsaw
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic was a testing ground for the coworking space understood as a concept that became popular as a result of the 2008 financial crisis. It raised questions regarding the vulnerability of coworking spaces (CWS), the evolution of their business models and the impact of coworking spaces on the city. The main aim of the paper was to investigate whether the evolution of coworking spaces is shifting towards the ‘social club’ model or the ‘business hub’ model and what is the impact of this shift on urban structure and thereby socio-spatial and economic urban resilience. The analysis draws upon the longitudinal research of all the coworking spaces carried out in Warsaw between 2008 and 2021, individual semi-structured interviews with real estate market stakeholders and city authorities, as well as structured covert participant observations. Our findings show that the evolution of coworking spaces is shifting towards the corporate ‘business hub’ rather than the bottom-up ‘social club’ model, and that the development of CWSs throughout the pandemic clearly strengthened the position of the Central Business District (CBD). In longer perspective this shift towards monocentric urban structure can potentially hinder the overall urban economic and socio-spatial resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了COVID-19疫情期间联合办公空间的演变趋势，发现其从自下而上的'社交俱乐部'模式转向企业化的'商业中心'模式，这种转变强化了中央商务区的地位，可能对城市经济和社会空间韧性产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 联合办公空间的演变是趋向于'社交俱乐部'模式还是'商业中心'模式？这种转变对城市结构和城市韧性有何影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情成为检验联合办公空间韧性的试验场，引发了对其脆弱性、商业模式演变及其对城市影响的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合办公空间演变理论、城市韧性理论、城市空间结构理论
AI.method: 纵向研究（2008-2021年华沙所有联合办公空间）、半结构化访谈（房地产利益相关者和城市当局）、结构化隐蔽参与观察
AI.findings: 联合办公空间向企业化'商业中心'模式转变，而非自下而上的'社交俱乐部'模式；疫情期间CWS发展强化了中央商务区地位；长期来看，向单中心城市结构的转变可能阻碍城市经济和社会空间韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对联合办公空间演变模式的理解，拓展了城市韧性理论在联合办公空间背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了关于联合办公空间发展对城市结构影响的实证依据，有助于制定促进城市韧性的空间规划策略
