title: Kenya's ESG Disclosure Maturity and Africa's Path from Reporting to Risk Pricing

detail.title: Kenya's ESG Disclosure Maturity and Africa's Path from Reporting to Risk Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract:
This paper, Kenya’s ESG Disclosure Maturity and Africa’s Path from Reporting to Risk Pricing, examines how Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) disclosure is transforming from a reporting exercise into a determinant of capital allocation across African markets. Using data from the Risk Insights ESG GPS™ platform for 2023/2024, the study benchmarks Kenya’s ESG maturity against South Africa’s, revealing distinct trajectories in environmental, social, and governance transparency. For Kenya, 32% of listed firms disclose Net Zero commitments, while only 12.5% report Scope 1 and 2 emissions, and 7% report Scope 3 emissions. Water and waste disclosure remain minimal, at 18% and 3.6%, respectively. South Africa demonstrates broader coverage (30–36% across environmental metrics) but limited depth in performance-based reporting. Despite progress in board diversity and governance transparency, both markets face significant challenges in assurance, standardized frameworks, and procurement disclosure.

The paper argues that ESG data has become a proxy for market credibility, directly influencing access to capital, credit spreads, and sovereign risk pricing. By aligning with IFRS S1/S2, GRI, TCFD, and CSRD, African issuers can integrate into global sustainable finance ecosystems and qualify for green, social, and sustainability-linked (GSS+) instruments in a bond market exceeding USD 5 trillion. Empirical insights show that firms with robust ESG disclosure in emerging markets achieve up to 20 basis points lower borrowing costs, underscoring the financial value of transparency.

The study concludes that Africa’s transition from reporting to risk pricing hinges on three pillars: (1) regulatory enforcement of standardized ESG templates, (2) assurance and data comparability across exchanges, and (3) integration of Africa-native ESG intelligence into investment models. Moving from symbolic disclosure to measurable impact will position African markets as credible participants in the next generation of sustainable capital flows.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了肯尼亚和南非的ESG披露成熟度，发现ESG数据正从报告工具转变为资本配置的决定因素。肯尼亚在净零承诺披露方面领先（32%），但排放报告不足；南非覆盖范围更广但深度有限。研究强调ESG透明度可降低新兴市场企业20个基点的借贷成本，并提出非洲从报告转向风险定价的三个支柱。
AI.research_question: ESG披露如何从报告工具转变为非洲市场资本配置的决定因素？
AI.motivation: 随着全球可持续金融生态系统的发展，ESG数据已成为市场信誉的代理指标，直接影响资本获取、信用利差和主权风险定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG披露成熟度理论、可持续金融理论、风险定价理论
AI.method: 使用Risk Insights ESG GPS™平台的2023/2024年数据，对肯尼亚和南非的ESG披露进行基准比较分析
AI.findings: 肯尼亚32%的上市公司披露净零承诺，但仅12.5%报告范围1和2排放；南非环境指标覆盖率达30-36%但深度有限；ESG披露稳健的企业在新兴市场可获得20个基点的借贷成本优势
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了非洲从ESG报告向风险定价转型的理论框架，强调ESG数据作为市场信誉代理的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲发行人提供了融入全球可持续金融生态系统的路径，明确了标准化ESG模板、数据可比性和本地ESG情报整合三个关键实施支柱

title: Digitalization without Diversification: Constraints and Potentials of Azerbaijan's ICT Sector in the Post-Oil Economy
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Digitalization without Diversification: Constraints and Potentials of Azerbaijan's ICT Sector in the Post-Oil Economy
detail.abstract: The Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) sector holds strategic importance for Azerbaijan's ambitions to diversify beyond hydrocarbons and modernize its national economy. Yet, despite extensive public investment and infrastructure development, the sector's contribution to GDP, employment, and exports remains limited. Drawing on official statistics and policy documents for 2020-2025, this study examines the performance, structure, and constraints of Azerbaijan's ICT and digital economy. In 2024, ICT accounted for only 1.8 percent of GDP, 0.036 percent of total exports, and 1.4 percent of national employment. Research and development (R&D) expenditure remained below 0.3 percent of GDP, while Azerbaijan ranked 94th in the 2025 Global Innovation Index-well behind regional peers. The paper attributes the sector's underperformance to low innovation intensity, weak private-sector participation, and overreliance on state-led infrastructure projects such as Azercosmos, which, while symbolically important, have not produced broad technological spillovers. At the same time, Azerbaijan has made measurable progress in digital finance, with non-cash payments rising from 30 percent in 2021 to 64.2 percent in 2024. These advances, however, have not translated into a robust, innovation-driven ICT ecosystem. The findings suggest that Azerbaijan's digital transformation remains infrastructure-heavy but innovation-light, requiring a shift toward policies that promote R&D investment, entrepreneurial capacity, and integration into global digital value chains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了阿塞拜疆ICT部门的绩效、结构和制约因素，发现尽管政府大力投资基础设施，但该部门对GDP、就业和出口的贡献有限，主要原因是创新强度低、私营部门参与弱、过度依赖国家主导的基础设施项目。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆ICT和数字经济部门的绩效、结构及制约因素是什么？
AI.motivation: ICT部门对阿塞拜疆实现经济多元化具有战略重要性，但尽管有大量公共投资和基础设施发展，该部门的经济贡献仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新经济学和发展经济学的理论框架，分析基础设施投资与创新生态系统发展的关系。
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年的官方统计数据和政策文件进行分析。
AI.findings: 2024年ICT仅占GDP的1.8%、总出口的0.036%、就业的1.4%；研发支出低于GDP的0.3%；全球创新指数排名第94位；数字金融取得进展但未形成创新驱动的ICT生态系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了基础设施投资与创新生态系统发展之间的脱节，提出了"基础设施重但创新轻"的数字转型模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策转向促进研发投资、创业能力和融入全球数字价值链，为阿塞拜疆及其他类似经济体提供政策启示。

title: Disconnectedness Brings Robustness? On Network Design For Matching With Vertex Interdiction
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Institute of Operations Research and Analytics and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Disconnectedness Brings Robustness? On Network Design For Matching With Vertex Interdiction
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the design of sparse networks that support large matchings under adversarial vertex deletions (vertex interdiction). Unlike prior literature that assumes i.i.d. disruptions, we consider the adversarial setting and explore the structural properties of optimal networks. We first study the sparsest graph that supports the same matching size as the complete graph and find that connected structures - particularly, the chain-type graphs - are optimal under certain conditions. However, when sparsity constraints become more stringent relative to the number of deleted vertices, disconnected structures - such as cluster-type graphs (disjoint unions of cliques) - can be optimal. We analyze the performance of regular chains and clusters, illustrating the transition from chains to clusters as the better design. Our analysis suggests that the latter is more robust to disruption (both in terms of the mode of disruption and the number of vertices deleted), making it more advantageous in high-stress environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在对抗性顶点删除下支持大匹配的稀疏网络设计。研究发现，在稀疏约束相对较松时，链型连通结构最优；但在更严格的稀疏约束下，聚类型（不相交团的并集）非连通结构更优。聚类结构对破坏更具鲁棒性，在高压力环境中更有优势。
AI.research_question: 在对抗性顶点删除下，支持大匹配的最优稀疏网络结构是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献假设独立同分布的中断，但现实中的网络破坏往往是敌对性的，需要研究对抗性设置下的最优网络结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图论中的匹配理论、顶点删除问题、网络鲁棒性分析
AI.method: 理论分析，研究链型图和聚类型图的结构特性，比较它们在对抗性顶点删除下的性能
AI.findings: 1. 稀疏约束较松时，链型连通结构最优；2. 稀疏约束更严格时，聚类型非连通结构更优；3. 聚类结构对破坏模式和被删除顶点数量都更具鲁棒性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了对抗性顶点删除下稀疏网络设计的理论框架，揭示了从连通结构到非连通结构的最优性转变
AI.practical_contributions: 为高压力环境下的网络设计提供指导，聚类结构更适合对抗性破坏场景

title: KPI and OKR: A Dream Combination To Help You Successfully Execute Your Strategy

detail.title: KPI and OKR: A Dream Combination To Help You Successfully Execute Your Strategy
detail.abstract: This paper explores the complementary relationship between Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in driving strategic execution. It begins by addressing the differences between OKRs and KPIs, emphasizing their distinct purposes and methodologies. While KPIs monitor strategy execution, OKRs focus on achieving ambitious objectives. The paper highlights key contrasts, such as adaptability, transparency, and application in performance management. It introduces a seven-step OKR model that integrates both tools effectively, guiding organizations from strategy formulation to execution and monitoring. By combining KPIs and OKRs, organizations can balance operational stability with transformative progress for successful strategy execution.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了OKR和KPI在战略执行中的互补关系，提出了一个七步OKR模型来有效整合这两种工具，帮助组织在运营稳定性和变革进展之间取得平衡。
AI.research_question: OKR和KPI如何协同作用以推动战略执行？
AI.motivation: 解决OKR和KPI在战略执行中的混淆和误用问题，明确两者的区别和互补关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略执行理论、绩效管理理论、目标设定理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架，提出七步OKR整合模型
AI.findings: OKR和KPI具有不同的目的和方法论，KPI监控战略执行，OKR专注于实现雄心勃勃的目标，两者结合可以平衡运营稳定性和变革进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了OKR和KPI的理论区别，建立了整合两者的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了七步OKR模型，指导组织从战略制定到执行和监控的全过程，帮助组织有效结合KPIs和OKRs。

title: From Individual Responsibility to Organizational Environment Optimization: A Paradigmatic Transition Toward Post-Neoliberal Organizational Theory

detail.title: From Individual Responsibility to Organizational Environment Optimization: A Paradigmatic Transition Toward Post-Neoliberal Organizational Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the CEO of HOWAR Srl

detail.abstract: This contribution introduces a significant methodological evolution in organizational theory. Through a meta-analysis of an extensive corpus of publications and based on years of applied experience, we propose overcoming approaches centered exclusively on individual performance by integrating systematic optimization of organizational environments. We present the HOWAR© Formula as a new theoretical foundation for post-neoliberal organizational science, establishing the basis for understanding human behavior through the dynamic interaction between individual identity and organizational environment. The research positions environmental quality as the primary lever for sustainable organizational performance while respecting human dignity and authenticity, proposing a paradigm shift from individual adaptation to systematic optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HOWAR©公式作为后新自由主义组织科学的新理论基础，通过整合组织环境的系统优化来超越仅关注个人绩效的方法，强调环境质量是可持续组织绩效的主要杠杆。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合个人身份与组织环境的动态互动来建立后新自由主义组织科学的新理论基础？
AI.motivation: 克服仅关注个人绩效的局限性，通过系统优化组织环境来实现可持续的组织绩效，同时尊重人类尊严和真实性。
AI.theoretical_framework: HOWAR©公式作为后新自由主义组织科学的新理论基础，强调个人身份与组织环境的动态互动。
AI.method: 基于大量文献的元分析和多年应用经验。
AI.findings: 环境质量是可持续组织绩效的主要杠杆，需要从个体适应转向系统优化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了HOWAR©公式作为组织科学的新理论基础，建立了理解人类行为的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了从个体适应到环境系统优化的实践指导，促进可持续绩效和人类尊严的平衡。

reference: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-030
title: AI for Proactive Mental Health: A Longitudinal, Multi-Institutional Trial
affiliations: , Stanford University, Chapman University, University of Washington, Foothill College and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: AI for Proactive Mental Health: A Longitudinal, Multi-Institutional Trial

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-030

detail.abstract: Young adults today face unprecedented mental health challenges, yet many hesitate to seek support due to barriers such as accessibility, stigma, and time constraints. Bite-sized well-being interventions offer a promising solution to preventing mental distress before it escalates to clinical levels, but have not yet been delivered through personalized, interactive, and scalable technology. We conducted the first multi-institutional, longitudinal, preregistered randomized controlled trial of a generative AI-powered mobile app (“Flourish”) designed to address this gap. Over six weeks in Fall 2024, 486 undergraduate students from three U.S. institutions were randomized to receive app access or waitlist control. Participants in the treatment condition reported significantly greater positive affect, resilience, and social well-being (i.e., increased belonging, closeness to community, and reduced loneliness) and were buffered against declines in mindfulness and flourishing. These findings suggest that, with purposeful and ethical design, generative AI can deliver proactive, population-level well-being interventions that produce measurable benefits.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验验证了生成式AI驱动的移动应用Flourish在提升大学生心理健康方面的有效性，发现该应用能显著增强积极情绪、韧性和社交幸福感，并缓冲正念和繁荣感的下降。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI驱动的移动应用能否有效提升大学生的心理健康水平？
AI.motivation: 当代年轻人面临前所未有的心理健康挑战，但许多人不愿寻求支持，主要障碍包括可及性、污名化和时间限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预防性心理健康干预理论和数字健康干预框架，强调在心理困扰升级到临床水平之前进行干预的重要性。
AI.method: 多机构、纵向、预注册的随机对照试验，在2024年秋季对来自三所美国大学的486名本科生进行为期6周的干预研究。
AI.findings: 实验组参与者报告了显著更高的积极情绪、韧性和社交幸福感（归属感增强、社区亲近度提高、孤独感减少），并且在正念和繁荣感方面避免了下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了生成式AI可以用于提供主动的、群体层面的心理健康干预，并产生可衡量的益处，为数字心理健康干预理论提供了新的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个个性化、互动性强且可扩展的生成式AI移动应用，为大规模实施预防性心理健康干预提供了可行的技术解决方案。

title: Agile Mindset Leaders and Their Experience-Based Tacit Knowledge Absorption Mastery: Polish-Finnish, Technological, and Non-Technological Leaders’ View
affiliations: Gdańsk University of Technology, Gdańsk University of Technology, Häme University of Applied Sciences and Gdańsk University of Technology - Faculty of Management and Economics

detail.title: Agile Mindset Leaders and Their Experience-Based Tacit Knowledge Absorption Mastery: Polish-Finnish, Technological, and Non-Technological Leaders’ View

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study
declarations.ethicsApproval: Respondents voluntarily participated in the research, and their anonymity was fully respected and secured.
declarations.funderStatement: The presented research results from the project ‘Agile learning culture influence on dynamic capabilities of knowledge-based organizations: Polish-Finnish cross-country analysis,’ No. UMO 2022/47/B/HS4/00597, financed by the National Science Center (NCN), Poland.

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Conference on Knowledge Management, volume 26, issue 1, 2025[10.34190/eckm.26.1.3933]

detail.abstract: Agile mindset leaders are central to agile organizations driven by knowledge. Previous studies have enabled us to assume that constant, tacit knowledge acquisition appears to be a valuable effect of constant agile learning, contributing to the intellectual mastery of agile leaders. Therefore, the question to which this study is dedicated is: Which competencies (demonstrated skills) do agile mindset leaders perceive as critical for their tacit knowledge acquisition? As previous studies have shown, technological and non-technological mindsets can see agile leadership differently. Therefore, this study aims to investigate whether there are any differences in the informal learning habits of agile mindset leaders in the IT sector compared to other sectors, as perceived by employees in Poland and Finland. A qualitative, interpretive approach, supported by MAXQDA software, is employed to achieve this. Results showed that contextual learning, learning from experiences (both positive and negative), learning from failures and mistakes, critical thinking, constant analysis and synthesis, seeking understanding, and systematic self-development are habitual skills-key informal learning activities employed by agile mindsets. Additionally, employees from other sectors highlighted the value of agile mindset leaders' habit of supporting others; IT employees specified these habits as giving constructive feedback and serving as mentors or coaches. Other sector employees also emphasized that 'scenario thinking' and self-discipline are habits that support the informal learning of agile mindset leaders. Apart from minor details, no significant differences were noted between Poland and Finland.

title: Justice for the Global Poor Requires Pro-Growth Policies by Rich Countries

detail.title: Justice for the Global Poor Requires Pro-Growth Policies by Rich Countries
detail.abstract: There is general agreement that global poverty is an urgent moral challenge that rich countries have a particular duty to help bring to an end. We argue that this challenge cannot be met without enormous and rapid economic growth. We argue further that rich country governments should deploy not only their tax revenues and geopolitical influence, but also their whole economies in this struggle. Pro-growth policies create and share opportunities and technologies crucial to poorer countries' economic development. Finally we consider and reject the environmentalist challenge that our proposal is self-defeating because growth causes environmental damage that particularly harms the poor. Escaping from poverty is the most effective way to increase resilience to threats like climate change.

detail.abstract: This study examines the education system in Egypt, focusing on the history, structure, and policies of education implemented. The modernization of education in Egypt began with the arrival of Napoleon Bonaparte in 1798, which brought the influence of science and technology from Europe. The Egyptian education system consists of two parallel structures, namely the secular system and the Al-Azhar religious system. Primary education in Egypt includes primary school (Ibtida'i) for 5 years, junior high school (I'dadi) for 3 years, and high school (Tsanawiyah 'Ammah) for 3 years, followed by higher education. Egypt's education policy emphasizes compulsory learning, the development of science, and the relevance of education to the needs of society. This study uses a qualitative approach with a literature study method to analyze various aspects of the Egyptian education system, including curriculum, management, and evaluation. The results of the study show that the Egyptian education system is unique in the integration of secular and religious education, as well as modernization efforts that continue to be carried out. The study also compares Egypt's education systems with Indonesia's to identify best practices that can be adopted to improve the quality of education in Indonesia.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest related to this research.

detail.abstract:
India’s education system continues to face persistent challenges in access and quality. We
examine the role and constraints of private sector participation by combining historical, legal, and
judicial analysis with primary research in the form of stakeholder interviews. We review India’s
ideological and constitutional precedents to trace how national ideals have shaped an unfriendly policy climate for private providers. We then analyze key regulations and court judgements, supplemented with interviews of parents, school administrators, and ed-tech founders to assess ground-level realities. We find that while private schools serve nearly half of students in India and are perceived by parents as superior to government schools across infrastructure, accountability, and outcomes, though they remain restricted by fee caps, nonprofit mandates, and administrative compliance burdens. Our results suggest that regulatory and ideological barriers constrain private initiatives to innovate, invest, and develop and run private institutions. We argue for reforms emphasizing streamlined approvals, outcome-based policy, and public-private partnerships to unlock the private sector’s potential while balancing equity in access.

declarations.funderStatement: Not funded

detail.abstract: The Entropic Markov Wealth Model (EMWM) presents a novel method for forecasting financial sustainability by integrating entropy-based disorder measures and behavioral-energy coefficients into a probabilistic state model. The framework models transitions among key wealth states-Growth, Drift, Decay, and Renewal-through entropy-weighted probabilities that reflect dynamic behavioral patterns and external influences. It introduces a Wealth Stability Index (WSI), quantifying systemic resilience and behavioral bias effects in individual, corporate, and national financial systems. This paper provides a conceptual overview of the model, mathematical logic, and use cases across financial forecasting, portfolio optimization, and macroeconomic stability assessment.

detail.abstract: The synergy of the KLC approach components (knowledge, learning, and collaboration cultures) supports a knowledge-driven organization's sustainability. However, given the profound alleged "synergy" between the KLC cultures, the question arises: How does this synergy occur? Based on the former studies, it is assumed that a collaborative culture appears to be the unifying and synergy-driving force of all cultures incorporated into the KLC approach. However, learning culture is at the center of the KLC's power to support collective intelligence development in knowledge-driven organizations. This study aims to study more in-depth how learning culture components, learning climate, and mistakes acceptance component as a source of learning interact, based on Kucharska's and Karwowska's (2025) 'KLC-sustainability' model. To do so, a moderation analysis is performed based on a sample of 496 Polish knowledge workers using the ordinary least squares (OLS) regression method. Results showed that a strong learning culture has a high potential to neutralize the adverse effects of the double bias of mistakes.

title: One Size Doesn't Fit All: Exploring Gendered Insights into Job Satisfaction and Employee Retention in HEI in India

detail.title: One Size Doesn't Fit All: Exploring Gendered Insights into Job Satisfaction and Employee Retention in HEI in India
detail.abstract: This study investigates the determinants of job satisfaction and their impact on employee retention within Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), with job satisfaction serving as a mediating variable and gender as a moderating factor. Employing a robust hybrid Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) approach, the study analyzes the influence of five key antecedents-compensation, work environment, job security, career advancement, and recognition-on job satisfaction and, in turn, on retention. The results reveal that all five factors significantly and positively contribute to job satisfaction, with job security and career advancement emerging as the most influential. Job satisfaction was found to significantly enhance employee retention, underscoring its pivotal role in sustaining a committed academic workforce. The multi-group analysis (MGA) identified gender-based differences, with male employees prioritizing compensation and job security, while female employees showed a stronger preference for a supportive work environment. However, both genders equally valued career advancement and recognition. These findings offer valuable insights for HEI administrators and policymakers, suggesting the need for holistic, inclusive, and demographically sensitive HR strategies that foster long-term commitment and institutional effectiveness.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Theragnostic Entropic Framework™, a unified system for modeling, predicting, and regulating human behavioral entropy within dynamic enterprises, financial systems, and broader socio-technical ecosystems. Rooted in three patented inventions-Theragnostic AI for Enterprise Operations (TAO), Entropic Markov Model (EMM), and Entropic Markov Wealth Model (EMWM)-the framework establishes a closed-loop architecture that senses inefficiency, predicts behavioral drift, and prescribes adaptive interventions. By combining thermodynamic entropy, behavioral science, and adaptive AI, the framework defines a new discipline of theragnostic intelligence: systems capable of self-diagnosis, learning, and autonomous stabilization.

detail.abstract: Educational change is very common, but is frequently hindered because teachers’ psychological; response to change is poorly addressed. The theory of planned behavior illustrates this well, especially with due recognition that psychological responses contain both conscious and subconscious thinking. Policy usually targets conscious; engagement, but automatic habitual thinking is more prevalent and can be a large factor. The shift to online instruction during COVID-19 is a useful context to show this works, but the issues are relevant in almost any substantial organizational change.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了教育变革中教师心理反应的重要性，指出变革常因忽视教师心理反应而受阻。计划行为理论表明，心理反应包含意识和潜意识思维，但政策通常只针对意识层面，而自动习惯思维更为普遍且影响重大。COVID-19期间的在线教学转型为这一现象提供了实证背景。
AI.research_question: 教育变革中教师的心理反应如何影响变革实施效果？特别是意识和潜意识思维在变革过程中的作用机制是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论，强调心理反应包含意识和潜意识两个维度，自动习惯思维在教育变革中具有重要作用。

AI.findings: 教师的心理反应对教育变革成功至关重要，潜意识层面的自动习惯思维比意识层面的理性思考更具影响力，政策制定需要同时考虑这两个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了计划行为理论在教育变革领域的应用，强调了潜意识思维在变革过程中的关键作用，为理解变革阻力提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了实践指导，建议在推动变革时不仅要关注教师的理性认知，更要重视和干预其潜意识习惯思维，以提高变革成功率。

title: Ethical and Managerial Challenges in Elder Care Institutions
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Ethical and Managerial Challenges in Elder Care Institutions
detail.abstract: Elder-care institutions play a vital role in supporting ageing populations, yet they operate in environments marked by complex ethical, managerial, and societal challenges. As longevity increases worldwide, care systems face pressure to balance quality, autonomy, and accountability while responding to limited resources and workforce constraints. This doctoral thesis investigates the ethical and managerial dilemmas confronting elder-care institutions, focusing on how leadership, organisational culture, and professional ethics interact to shape the quality of care and the dignity of older adults. Using a qualitative narrative-synthesis methodology, this research integrates evidence from international literature, policy frameworks, and case studies spanning Europe, North America, and Asia (2015-2025). The study applies an ethical-decision-making and adaptive-leadership framework to explore tensions between institutional efficiency and human-centred care. It identifies recurrent ethical challenges, including staff shortages, moral distress, neglect risks, and the balancing of residents' autonomy with safety and legal compliance. Findings reveal that effective elder-care management depends not solely on regulations or technical competence but on ethical leadership, organisational empathy, and a culture of moral accountability. Institutions with participatory management, transparent communication, and structured ethics training demonstrate higher staff satisfaction and reduced ethical conflict. The thesis proposes an Ethical-Managerial Integration Framework (EMIF) to guide decision-making, aligning ethical principles with managerial pragmatism and care quality. The study contributes to the fields of gerontology, healthcare management, and applied ethics by offering a multi-level understanding of elder-care governance. It calls for rehumanising institutional care through compassion-led leadership, continuous professional development, and ethically informed policy design that respects both carers and care recipients.

title: An Analysis of U.S. Public Pension Fund Allocations to Cryptocurrency and Precious Metals
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: An Analysis of U.S. Public Pension Fund Allocations to Cryptocurrency and Precious Metals
detail.abstract: The investment strategies of U.S. public pension funds are critical to fiscal stability. Confronted with return challenges and elevated liabilities, these funds are diversifying into alternative assets with differentiated risk-return profiles. This study examines a measurable trend: allocations to cryptocurrency-related equities and precious metals. Using quarterly Form 13F-HR filings (Q1 2024-Q2 2025) for seventeen major funds, we quantify the scale and structure of these exposures, which grew to $3.3 billion (crypto) and $2.2 billion (metals) by mid-2025. Our central finding is a strong and growing institutional preference for indirect exposure through equity proxies like MicroStrategy and Newmont Corporation, rather than direct ownership or ETF positions. This indicates a cautious approach to incorporating new asset classes, balancing innovation within traditional fiduciary and governance frameworks. The results illuminate the evolving role of alternative assets in long-term public investment strategy.

AI.tldr: 美国公共养老基金正在通过投资加密货币相关股票和贵金属来分散投资组合，到2025年中规模分别达到33亿美元和22亿美元，主要采用间接持股而非直接投资的方式。
AI.research_question: 美国公共养老基金如何通过投资加密货币相关股票和贵金属来应对回报挑战和负债压力？

title: Developing Life Skills Training Models for Mental Health Professionals
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Developing Life Skills Training Models for Mental Health Professionals
detail.abstract:
The increasing prevalence of mental-health challenges worldwide demands not only clinical competence among mental-health professionals but also holistic life skills — including communication, empathy, emotional intelligence, ethical reasoning, and resilience. These human competencies are essential for maintaining well-being, professionalism, and ethical integrity within emotionally demanding work environments.

This doctoral study investigates how life skills training can be systematically integrated into mental-health education and professional development frameworks. Using a qualitative narrative-synthesis methodology, the research analyses theoretical and empirical literature published between 2015 and 2025, alongside global training models and policy frameworks. The objective is to construct a Life Skills Competency Development Framework (LSCDF) tailored to the needs of mental-health professionals, bridging the gap between clinical knowledge and personal mastery.

Findings reveal that life skills such as emotional regulation, reflective communication, leadership, and ethical self-awareness significantly enhance therapeutic effectiveness, teamwork, and client satisfaction. However, the study identifies major barriers including limited institutional curricula, inconsistent training standards, and cultural misconceptions about “soft skills.” The LSCDF developed through this research provides a structured model integrating cognitive, emotional, and behavioural domains to cultivate sustainable professional growth and psychological resilience.

The study concludes that life skills are not auxiliary attributes but core competencies for ethical and effective mental-health practice. The proposed framework offers practical pathways for educators, administrators, and policymakers to embed life-skills training within academic programmes, supervision systems, and institutional leadership development — aligning with the World Health Organization’s (WHO) Mental Health Action Plan (2013–2030) and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (Good Health and Well-Being).

title: Strategic Leadership Models for Sustainable Mental Health Organisations
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Strategic Leadership Models for Sustainable Mental Health Organisations
detail.abstract: Mental-health organisations operate in complex and high-pressure environments where clinical excellence must coexist with financial accountability, ethical care, and workforce resilience. Sustainability in such settings depends not only on resource management but on strategic leadership models that integrate purpose, people, and policy. This doctoral thesis investigates strategic leadership for sustainable mental-health organisations, examining how leaders foster cultures of compassion, innovation, and coproduction while navigating systemic challenges such as workforce shortages, limited funding, and fragmented governance. Drawing on a narrative-synthesis methodology, it reviews empirical and theoretical studies from 2015-2025 covering transformational, authentic, adaptive, and distributed-leadership paradigms. Findings indicate that sustainability arises when leaders create psychologically safe workplaces, empower multidisciplinary teams, share decision-making power with service users, and align organisational practices with broader health-policy and equity agendas. The research introduces a Strategic Leadership Sustainability Framework (SLSF) linking three core domains-People, Process, and Policy-to show how leadership behaviours translate into long-term organisational resilience and equitable outcomes. The thesis concludes that sustainable mental-health leadership demands a shift from hierarchical command models toward collaborative, learning-oriented systems grounded in ethical accountability. Its recommendations provide actionable guidance for managers, policymakers, and educators seeking to build a next generation of leaders capable of shaping just, inclusive, and future-ready mental-health systems.

detail.title: Proportionality in the EU's AMLCFT Framework: Strategic Approaches for AMLA

keywords.keywords: Regulatory Compliance; Financial Regulation; Banking; Proportionality; Risk Management; AMLA; and Financial Supervision

detail.abstract: This article examines strategic approaches for the European Union's Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AMLA) to embed proportionality within its AML/CFT regulatory framework. It advocates for principles-based regulation complemented by supervisory convergence mechanisms, such as peer reviews and joint supervisory efforts, to foster mutual trust and prevent regulatory arbitrage across member states. The paper highlights the importance of establishing a regulatory maturation process that enables continuous, risk-aligned development of rules through iterative review and stakeholder engagement. Additionally, it emphasises the role of comprehensive cost-benefit analyses that consider proportionality and EU competitiveness, benchmarking against international standards. By integrating these strategies, AMLA can create a proportionate, effective, and adaptable regulatory environment that supports the EU’s broader economic and supervisory objectives, ensuring the effectiveness and competitiveness of its AML/CFT regime from its inception.

title: Hierarchy Culture: Order Above All

detail.title: Hierarchy Culture: Order Above All

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a

detail.abstract: This article explores the nature, origins, and enduring significance of hierarchy culture as one of the core organizational culture types within the Competing Values Framework. Defined by order, control, and predictability, hierarchy culture prioritizes stability, efficiency, and compliance over flexibility or innovation. Drawing from classical theories of bureaucracy by Weber, Taylor, and Fayol, and integrating insights from modern institutional and contingency theory, the article examines how hierarchical systems sustain legitimacy, scale, and accountability across diverse contexts-from the U.S. Army and McDonald's to Toyota and global financial institutions. It analyzes the characteristic structures, leadership behaviors and communication patterns that make hierarchy both a source of reliability and a potential barrier to adaptability. The discussion further explores how hierarchy evolves as organizations mature and the tensions it creates in balancing control with responsiveness. Ultimately, the article argues that hierarchy's survival depends on adaptive hybridization-preserving its discipline and legitimacy while integrating flexibility to meet the demands of a dynamic world.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了竞争价值观框架中等级文化作为核心组织文化类型的本质、起源和持久意义。等级文化以秩序、控制和可预测性为特征，优先考虑稳定性、效率性和合规性而非灵活性或创新性。文章基于韦伯、泰勒和法约尔的经典官僚制理论，结合现代制度和权变理论，分析了等级制度如何在从美国陆军、麦当劳到丰田和全球金融机构等不同情境中维持合法性、规模和问责制。文章认为等级制度的生存依赖于适应性混合——在保持纪律和合法性的同时整合灵活性以满足动态世界的需求。
AI.research_question: 等级文化作为竞争价值观框架中的核心组织文化类型，其本质、起源和持久意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解等级文化在组织中的角色和演变，以及如何在现代动态环境中平衡控制与响应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争价值观框架、韦伯的官僚制理论、泰勒的科学管理理论、法约尔的管理理论、现代制度理论、权变理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，涵盖美国陆军、麦当劳、丰田和全球金融机构等不同组织。
AI.findings: 等级文化通过秩序、控制和可预测性提供可靠性和问责制，但可能阻碍适应性；等级制度随着组织成熟而演变，需要在控制与响应性之间取得平衡。

detail.abstract:
This white paper further examines the structural disparities embedded within artificial intelligence systems, as revealed by the 7 Races of AI Framework (previously published February 2, 2025, on SSRN). Through an empirical analysis of AI knowledge-tiering, it demonstrates how AI models—despite being constructed on binary logic—continues to exhibit discriminatory information-gating practices, limiting knowledge accessibility based on economic privilege and human based system-level governance.

By analyzing discrepancies in free-tier versus paid-tier AI responses, this study establishes that AI is not merely a passive knowledge tool but an assumed regulated ecosystem where access to what is often promoted as unarguable truth is monetized and controlled. The paper then introduces a regionalized AI governance strategy, tailored for policymakers and industry leaders in different global regions, helping to ensure that AI remains an equitable digital entity rather than a controlled gatekeeping system.

detail.abstract: This study examines resilience and nonmarket strategy from the perspective of University of Kansas professor Chang Hoon Oh's research. His research on how businesses deal with political, economic, and environmental uncertainty highlights a human aspect of corporate strategy that is frequently missed in technical debates. Based on my work background in technology, digital marketing, education, and human resources, I consider how resilience is a human as well as a corporate skill. The basis for both organizational and individual survival is the capacity to connect, learn, and adapt. The article comes to the conclusion that a successful strategy arises from striking a balance between system design, social connection, and common purpose in today's technologically fragile environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究从堪萨斯大学Chang Hoon Oh教授的视角探讨企业韧性与非市场战略，强调在技术讨论中常被忽视的企业战略中的人性层面。基于技术、数字营销、教育和人力资源的工作背景，作者认为韧性既是企业技能也是个人能力。在当今技术脆弱环境中，成功的战略需要在系统设计、社会联系和共同目标之间取得平衡。
AI.research_question: 企业如何在政治、经济和环境不确定性中发展韧性和非市场战略？
AI.motivation: 当前技术讨论中经常忽视企业战略的人性层面，需要从人类能力角度重新审视企业韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Chang Hoon Oh教授关于企业应对不确定性的研究框架，结合组织韧性和非市场战略理论。
AI.method: 基于作者在技术、数字营销、教育和人力资源领域的工作经验进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 韧性既是组织能力也是个人技能，连接、学习和适应的能力是组织和个体生存的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业韧性概念扩展到人类能力层面，强调战略中的人性因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了在技术脆弱环境中平衡系统设计、社会联系和共同目标的战略指导。

title: Economic Development Glossary

detail.title: Economic Development Glossary
detail.abstract: This glossary defines key terms in the field of economic development as used by the U.S. Economic Development Administration and other government agencies. It consolidates terminology from statutes, policy documents, and professional practice into a single reference to support clarity and consistency in economic development planning and implementation in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文是美国经济发展管理局制定的经济发展领域关键术语词汇表，旨在为美国经济发展规划和实施提供清晰统一的术语参考。

AI.motivation: 经济发展领域的术语在不同法规、政策文件和专业实践中存在不一致，需要统一参考标准来支持规划和实施的清晰性。

AI.method: 文献整理和术语汇编方法，整合来自法规、政策文件和专业实践的术语定义。

title: People versus Places: Elite Persistence after the Fall of the Ming
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics and University of Colorado

detail.title: People versus Places: Elite Persistence after the Fall of the Ming
detail.abstract: We study how elite power persisted through the Ming–Qing transition in Central China. Using genealogical microdata on married couples and their descendants, linked to measures of local elite influence, we estimate the effects of the Ming collapse (1368–1644) on families (people) and on regions (places). A family line-level treatment and control approach shows that elites experienced an immediate loss of influence, but their descendants recovered and consolidated elite status under the Qing (1644–1911). In contrast, a region-level design indicates that areas more heavily exposed to Ming-collapse destruction suffered persistent adverse outcomes. Evidence on career choice is consistent with a trauma-induced shift toward civil service examination careers, with stronger intergenerational transmission of exam-oriented norms in families more exposed to destruction. The results document adaptive persistence of elite families despite regime change, alongside lasting regional scarring, and highlight the role of cultural transmission in the persistence of elite status.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了明清鼎革时期中国中部地区精英权力的持续性。通过家谱微观数据分析发现，精英家族在明朝灭亡后经历了短暂影响力下降，但后代在清朝时期恢复并巩固了精英地位。相反，受战乱破坏更严重的地区遭受了持久的不利影响。证据表明文化传承在精英地位持续性中发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 明清鼎革时期精英权力如何在中国中部地区持续存在？
AI.motivation: 理解政权更迭期间精英阶层的适应性和持续性机制，以及地区破坏的长期影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 精英持续性理论、文化传承理论、政权更迭影响理论
AI.method: 使用家谱微观数据，结合家庭层面和地区层面的双重设计方法，分析已婚夫妇及其后代数据
AI.findings: 精英家族在明朝灭亡后立即失去影响力，但后代在清朝恢复精英地位；受战乱破坏严重的地区遭受持久不利影响；文化传承在精英地位持续性中发挥关键作用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了精英在政权更迭中的适应性持续性理论，强调了文化传承在精英地位代际传递中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史政权更迭对精英阶层和地区发展的长期影响提供了实证证据，对现代社会治理具有启示意义
